title.zh: 卷六十三 志第十六 五行二上
title.raw: 卷六十三 志第十六 五行二上 Volume 63 Treatises 16: Five Elements 2a

sentences.zh: 炎上，火之性也。

translations.literal: Flaming upward is the nature of fire.
translations.idiomatic: To blaze upward is the nature of Fire.

sentences.zh: 火失其性，則爲災眚。

translations.literal: When fire loses its nature, it becomes calamity and prodigy.
translations.idiomatic: When Fire loses its nature, disaster and portents follow.

sentences.zh: 舊說以恒燠、草妖、羽蟲之孽，羊禍、赤眚、赤祥之類皆屬之火，今從之。

translations.literal: Older doctrine holds that enduring heat, grass monsters, portents among feathered creatures, sheep calamities, red prodigies, red omens of this kind—all belong to fire; the present text follows this.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier authorities assigned enduring heat, grass prodigies, calamities among winged creatures, sheep portents, red aberrations, and red omens of that sort to Fire; this chapter follows that classification.

sentences.zh: 建隆元年，宿州火，燔民舍萬余區。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jianlong, Suzhou had fire; it burned more than ten thousand sections of common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jianlong (960), Suzhou caught fire and burned more than ten thousand household compounds.

sentences.zh: 二年三月，內酒坊火，燔舍百八十區，酒工死者三十余。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year, the inner imperial brewery caught fire; it burned one hundred eighty sections of buildings, and more than thirty brewers died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year (961), the imperial brewery within the palace caught fire, destroying one hundred eighty buildings and killing more than thirty brewers.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，滑州甲仗庫火。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, Huazhou's armor and weapons depot caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year (962), the armor and weapons depot at Huazhou caught fire.

sentences.zh: 燔儀門及軍資庫一百九十區，兵器、錢帛並盡。

translations.literal: It burned the ceremonial gate and military supply depot in one hundred ninety sections; weapons, coin, and silks were all destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: The blaze consumed the ceremonial gate and military supply depot—one hundred ninety structures in all—and destroyed every weapon, coin, and length of silk stored there.

sentences.zh: 開封府通許鎮民家火。

translations.literal: Common households at Tongxu town in Kaifeng prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: Fire broke out among the homes of Tongxu town in Kaifeng prefecture.

sentences.zh: 燔廬舍三百四十余區。

translations.literal: It burned more than three hundred forty sections of lodgings.
translations.idiomatic: More than three hundred forty dwellings were burned.

sentences.zh: 二月，安州牙吏施延業家火。

translations.literal: In the second month, the home of Anzhou clerk Shi Yan'ye caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, fire broke out at the home of Shi Yan'ye, a clerk of the Anzhou military commission.

sentences.zh: 燔民舍並顯義軍營六百余區。

translations.literal: It burned common dwellings together with the Xianyi Army camp in more than six hundred sections.
translations.idiomatic: The fire consumed more than six hundred structures, including private homes and the Xianyi Army barracks.

sentences.zh: 五月，京師相國寺火，燔舍數百區。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Xiangguo Temple in the capital caught fire and burned several hundred sections of buildings.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Xiangguo Temple in the capital caught fire and burned several hundred structures.

sentences.zh: 海州火，燔數百家，死者十八人。

translations.literal: Haizhou had fire; it burned several hundred households, and eighteen people died.
translations.idiomatic: Haizhou caught fire; several hundred homes were burned and eighteen people perished.

sentences.zh: 乾德四年二月，岳州衙署、稟庫火，燔市肆、民舍殆盡，官吏逾城僅免。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year of Qiande, Yuezhou's government offices and granary caught fire; market stalls and common dwellings were nearly all burned, and officials fled over the city wall barely escaping.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year of Qiande (966), fire struck the yamen and state granary at Yuezhou, consuming nearly all the shops and homes in the city; officials escaped over the wall with their lives barely intact.

sentences.zh: 三月，陳州火，燔民舍數十區。

translations.literal: In the third month, Chenzhou had fire and burned several tens of sections of common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Chenzhou caught fire and burned several dozen household compounds.

sentences.zh: 潭州火，燔民舍五百余區；

translations.literal: Tanzhou had fire and burned more than five hundred sections of common dwellings;
translations.idiomatic: Tanzhou caught fire and burned more than five hundred household compounds;

sentences.zh: 逾月，民周澤家火，又燔倉稟、民舍數百區，死者三十六人。

translations.literal: After a month, the home of the commoner Zhou Ze caught fire; it again burned granary stores and common dwellings in several hundred sections, and thirty-six people died.
translations.idiomatic: A month later, fire broke out at the home of Zhou Ze, a local resident, and again consumed the granaries and hundreds of dwellings, killing thirty-six people.

sentences.zh: 是春，諸州言火者甚衆。

translations.literal: That spring, very many prefectures reported fire.
translations.idiomatic: That spring, reports of fire poured in from prefectures across the realm.

sentences.zh: 八月，衡州火，燔公署、倉庫、民舍僅千余區。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Hengzhou had fire; it burned government offices, warehouses, and common dwellings—nearly more than a thousand sections.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Hengzhou caught fire, destroying nearly a thousand structures among the government offices, warehouses, and private homes.

sentences.zh: 五年，京師建隆觀火。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the Jianlong Abbey in the capital caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, the Jianlong Abbey in the capital burned.

sentences.zh: 開寶三年八月，辰州廨火，燔軍資庫。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year of Kaibao, Chenzhou's government offices caught fire and burned the military supply depot.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year of Kaibao (970), fire struck the yamen at Chenzhou and destroyed the military supply depot.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，忠州火，倉庫殆盡。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year, Zhongzhou had fire; the warehouses were nearly all destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year (972), Zhongzhou caught fire and the warehouses were nearly all consumed.

sentences.zh: 七年九月，永城縣火，燔民舍一千八百余區。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the seventh year, Yongcheng county had fire and burned more than one thousand eight hundred sections of common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the seventh year (974), Yongcheng county caught fire and burned more than eighteen hundred household compounds.

sentences.zh: 八年四月，洋州火，燔州廨、民舍千七百區。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eighth year, Yangzhou had fire; it burned the prefectural offices and common dwellings in one thousand seven hundred sections.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the eighth year (975), Yangzhou caught fire, destroying the prefectural offices and seventeen hundred private dwellings.

sentences.zh: 永城縣火，燔軍營、民舍千九百八十區，死者九人。

translations.literal: Yongcheng county had fire; it burned army camps and common dwellings in one thousand nine hundred eighty sections, and nine people died.
translations.idiomatic: Yongcheng county caught fire again, consuming nineteen hundred eighty structures between the barracks and private homes and killing nine people.

sentences.zh: 太平興國七年八月，益州西倉災。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the seventh year of Taiping Xingguo, Yizhou's western granary suffered disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the seventh year of Taiping Xingguo (982), the western granary at Yizhou was destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 端拱元年二月，雲安軍威棹營火。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Duangong, the Weizhuo camp of Yun'an Army caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Duangong (988), the Weizhuo camp at Yun'an Army post caught fire.

sentences.zh: 二年三月，衡州火，燔州縣官舍、倉庫、軍營三百余區。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year, Hengzhou had fire; it burned prefectural and county government quarters, warehouses, and army camps in more than three hundred sections.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year (989), Hengzhou caught fire and burned more than three hundred structures among the prefectural and county offices, warehouses, and barracks.

sentences.zh: 又崇賢坊有鳥燔數十處，七日不滅。

translations.literal: Moreover, in Chongxian ward birds burned in several tens of places, and for seven days the fires did not go out.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongxian ward as well, birds burst into flame in dozens of spots, and the fires burned for seven days without dying out.

sentences.zh: 淳化三年十月，蔡州懷慶軍營火，燔汝河橋民居、官舍三千余區，死者數人。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year of Chunhua, the Huaiqing Army camp at Caizhou caught fire; it burned dwellings of common people and official quarters by the Ru River bridge in more than three thousand sections, and several people died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the third year of Chunhua (992), fire broke out at the Huaiqing Army camp in Caizhou, destroying more than three thousand homes and government buildings near the Ru River bridge and killing several people.

sentences.zh: 十二月，建安軍城西火，燔民舍、官廨等殆盡。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the west of Jian'an Army city caught fire; common dwellings, government offices, and the like were nearly all burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, fire swept the western part of Jian'an Army city, nearly consuming all private homes and government buildings.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，永州保安津舍火，飛焰過江，燒州門及民屋三百餘家。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year, the Bao'an ferry lodge at Yongzhou caught fire; flying flames crossed the river and burned the prefectural gate and more than three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year (993), the Bao'an ferry station at Yongzhou caught fire; flames leaped the river and burned the prefectural gate and more than three hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 咸平二年四月，池州倉火，燔米八萬七千斛。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Xianping, Chizhou's granary caught fire and burned eighty-seven thousand hu of rice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of Xianping (999), the granary at Chizhou caught fire and destroyed eighty-seven thousand hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 景德元年正月，平虜軍營火，焚民居廬舍甚衆。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Jingde, the Pinglu Army camp caught fire and burned very many common dwellings and lodgings.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Jingde (1004), the Pinglu Army camp caught fire and destroyed a great many civilian homes.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月，郢州火，燔倉庫並盡。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fourth year, Yingzhou had fire; the warehouses were all burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fourth year (1007), Yingzhou caught fire and the warehouses were completely destroyed.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符元年正月，桂州甲仗庫災。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Guizhou's armor and weapons depot suffered disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu (1008), the armor and weapons depot at Guizhou was destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，升州火，燔軍營、民舍殆盡。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year, Shengzhou had fire; army camps and common dwellings were nearly all burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year (1009), Shengzhou caught fire and nearly all the barracks and private homes were consumed.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，徐州草場火。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year, Xuzhou's hay field caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year (1011), the hay depot at Xuzhou caught fire.

sentences.zh: 十月，鎮州城樓、戰棚火。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Zhenzhou's city tower and battle sheds caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the city tower and siege sheds at Zhenzhou burned.

sentences.zh: 七月，雄州甲仗庫火。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Xiongzhou's armor and weapons depot caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the armor and weapons depot at Xiongzhou caught fire.

sentences.zh: 八年二月甲寅，宗正寺火。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighth year, on the jiayin day, the Court of the Imperial Clan caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the second month of the eighth year (1015), the Court of the Imperial Clan caught fire.

sentences.zh: 四月壬申夜，榮王元儼宮火，自三鼓北風甚，癸酉亭午乃止，延燔左承天祥符門、內藏庫、朝元殿、乾元門、崇文院、祕閣、天書法物內香藏庫。

translations.literal: On the night of renshen in the fourth month, Prince Yuan Yan's palace caught fire; from the third watch the north wind blew fiercely, and by wuzi at noon on guiyou it stopped, spreading to burn the Left Chengtian Xiangfu Gate, Inner Treasury, Chaoyuan Hall, Qianyuan Gate, Chongwen Institute, Secret Archives, Heavenly Writ ritual objects, and Inner Incense Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of renshen in the fourth month (1015), fire broke out at the palace of Prince Yuan Yan; from the third watch a fierce north wind drove the flames until they died at noon on guiyou, having spread to the Left Chengtian Xiangfu Gate, the Inner Treasury, Chaoyuan Hall, Qianyuan Gate, the Chongwen Institute, the Secret Archives, the repository of Heavenly Writ ritual objects, and the Inner Incense Treasury.

sentences.zh: 九年五月甲子，左天廄坊草場火。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year, on the jiazi day, the hay field of the Left Heavenly Stables Ward caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the fifth month of the ninth year (1016), the hay depot of the Left Heavenly Stables Ward caught fire.

sentences.zh: 天禧二年二月戊寅，北宅蔡州團練使德雍院火，延燔數百區。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Tianxi, on the wuyin day, the courtyard of Defu, regimental commander of Caizhou in the Northern Residence, caught fire and spread to burn several hundred sections.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the second month of the second year of Tianxi (1018), fire broke out at the courtyard of Defu, regimental commander of Caizhou in the Northern Residence, and spread to destroy several hundred structures.

sentences.zh: 三年春，京師多火。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year, the capital had many fires.
translations.idiomatic: That spring in the third year (1019), fires broke out repeatedly in the capital.

sentences.zh: 六月，永州軍營火，延民舍數百余區。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Yongzhou's army camp caught fire and spread to common dwellings in more than several hundred sections.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, fire at the Yongzhou barracks spread to more than four hundred private dwellings.

sentences.zh: 五年四月丁巳，事材場火。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year, on the dingsi day, the Building Materials Yard caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the fourth month of the fifth year (1021), the Building Materials Yard caught fire.

sentences.zh: 天聖三年二月丁卯，蘄州榷貨務火。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiansheng, in the second month on the dingmao day, Qizhou's Monopoly Goods Office caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the second month of the third year of Tiansheng (1025), the state monopoly office at Qizhou caught fire.

sentences.zh: 五年四月壬辰，壽寧觀火。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fifth year, on the renchen day, the Shouning Abbey caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the fourth month of the fifth year (1027), Shouning Abbey burned.

sentences.zh: 七年六月丁未，玉清昭應宮災。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year, on the dingwei day, the Yuqing Zhaoying Palace suffered disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the sixth month of the seventh year (1029), the Yuqing Zhaoying Palace was destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 初，大中祥符元年，詔建宮以藏天書。

translations.literal: At first, in the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu, an edict ordered construction of a palace to store the Heavenly Writs.
translations.idiomatic: The palace had been ordered built in the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu (1008) to house the Heavenly Writs.

sentences.zh: 七年，宮始成，凡二千六百一十楹。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the palace was first completed, altogether two thousand six hundred ten bays.
translations.idiomatic: It was finished in the seventh year (1014), with twenty-six hundred and ten bays in all.

sentences.zh: 至是，火發夜中，大雷雨，至曉而盡。

translations.literal: At this time, fire broke out in the middle of the night amid a great thunderstorm; by dawn all was consumed.
translations.idiomatic: When fire broke out at midnight amid a violent thunderstorm, the entire complex was gone by dawn.

sentences.zh: 明道元年八月壬戌，修文德殿成。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Mingdao, on the renxu day, the Xiuwende Hall was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the eighth month of the first year of Mingdao (1032), the Xiuwende Hall was completed.

sentences.zh: 是夜，禁中火，延燔崇德、長春、滋福、會慶、延慶、崇徽、天和、承明八殿。

translations.literal: That night, fire broke out within the Forbidden City and spread to burn the eight halls Chongde, Changchun, Zifu, Huiqing, Yanqing, Chonghui, Tianhe, and Chengming.
translations.idiomatic: That same night, fire broke out inside the palace and spread through eight halls: Chongde, Changchun, Zifu, Huiqing, Yanqing, Chonghui, Tianhe, and Chengming.

sentences.zh: 景祐三年七月庚子，太平興國寺火起閣中，延燔開先殿及寺舍數百楹。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingyou, in the seventh month on the gengzi day, fire broke out in the pavilion of Taiping Xingguo Temple and spread to burn the Kaixian Hall and several hundred bays of monastery buildings.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the seventh month of the third year of Jingyou (1036), fire started in the pagoda of Taiping Xingguo Temple and spread to the Kaixian Hall and several hundred monastery buildings.

sentences.zh: 是夕，大雨雹。

translations.literal: That evening, heavy rain and hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: That evening a storm of rain and hail struck.

sentences.zh: 十月巳酉，澶州橫龍水口西岸料物場火，焚薪芻一百九十余萬。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the siyou day, the materials depot on the west bank of Henglong Ford at Chenzhou caught fire and burned more than one million nine hundred thousand bundles of fuel and fodder.
translations.idiomatic: On siyou in the tenth month, the supply depot on the west bank of Henglong Ford at Chenzhou caught fire and destroyed more than 1.9 million bundles of fuel and fodder.

sentences.zh: 寶元二年六月丁丑，益州火，焚民廬舍二千余區。

translations.literal: In the second year of Baoyuan, in the sixth month on the dingchou day, Yizhou had fire and burned more than two thousand sections of common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the sixth month of the second year of Baoyuan (1039), Yizhou caught fire and destroyed more than two thousand homes.

sentences.zh: 康定元年六月乙未，南京鴻慶宮神御殿火。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangding, in the sixth month on the yiwei day, the Spirit Portrait Hall of Hongqing Palace at Nanjing caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the sixth month of the first year of Kangding (1040), the Spirit Portrait Hall of Hongqing Palace at Nanjing burned.

sentences.zh: 皇祐五年正月丁巳，會靈觀火。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Huangyou, in the first month on the dingsi day, the Huiling Abbey caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the first month of the fifth year of Huangyou (1053), Huiling Abbey burned.

sentences.zh: 至和元年四月辛丑，祥元觀火。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhihe, in the fourth month on the xinchou day, the Xiangyuan Abbey caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the fourth month of the first year of Zhihe (1054), Xiangyuan Abbey burned.

sentences.zh: 二年，并州太宗神御殿火。

translations.literal: In the second year, the Spirit Portrait Hall of Emperor Taizong at Bingzhou caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year (1055), the Spirit Portrait Hall of Emperor Taizong at Bingzhou burned.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐三年正月，溫州火，燔屋萬四千間，死者五十人。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year of Jiayou, Wenzhou had fire; it burned fourteen thousand rooms, and fifty people died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year of Jiayou (1058), Wenzhou caught fire, destroying fourteen thousand rooms and killing fifty people.

sentences.zh: 治平四年十二月壬子夜，睦親宮火，焚九百餘間。

translations.literal: On the night of renzi in the twelfth month of the fourth year of Zhiping, Mujin Palace caught fire and burned more than nine hundred rooms.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of renzi in the twelfth month of the fourth year of Zhiping (1067), Mujin Palace caught fire and destroyed more than nine hundred rooms.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，廣親宮又火。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Guangqin Palace again caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Guangqin Palace burned as well.

sentences.zh: 熙寧六年二月丙申，永昌陵上宮火，燔東城門。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Xining, in the second month on the bingshen day, the upper palace of Yongchang Mausoleum caught fire and burned the eastern city gate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the second month of the sixth year of Xining (1073), fire struck the upper palace at Yongchang Mausoleum and burned the eastern gate tower.

sentences.zh: 七年九月壬子，三司火，自巳至戌，焚屋千八百楹，案牘殆盡。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the seventh year, on the renzi day, the Three Departments caught fire; from si to xu it burned one thousand eight hundred bays of buildings, and the documents were nearly all destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the ninth month of the seventh year (1074), the Three Departments caught fire; from mid-morning until evening it consumed eighteen hundred bays of buildings and nearly all the archives.

sentences.zh: 十一月，洞眞宮火。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Dongzhen Palace caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Dongzhen Palace burned.

sentences.zh: 九年十月，魯王、濮王宮火。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the ninth year, the palaces of the Prince of Lu and the Prince of Pu caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the ninth year (1076), the palaces of the Prince of Lu and the Prince of Pu burned.

sentences.zh: 十年正月，仙韶院火。

translations.literal: In the first month of the tenth year, the Xianchao Court caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year (1077), the Xianchao Court caught fire.

sentences.zh: 撤屋二百五十楹。

translations.literal: Two hundred fifty bays of buildings were torn down.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred fifty bays of structures were demolished.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，開封府火。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the bingzi day, Kaifeng prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the third month, Kaifeng prefecture caught fire.

sentences.zh: 元祐元年三月，宗室宮院火。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Yuanyou, the imperial-clan palace compound caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Yuanyou (1086), the palace compound of the imperial clan burned.

sentences.zh: 六年十二月，開封府火。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the sixth year, Kaifeng prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the sixth year (1091), Kaifeng prefecture caught fire.

sentences.zh: 紹聖三年三月七日，內尚書省火，尋撲滅。

translations.literal: On the seventh day of the third month of the third year of Shaosheng, the Inner Secretariat caught fire and was soon extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh day of the third month of the third year of Shaosheng (1096), the Inner Secretariat caught fire but was quickly put out.

sentences.zh: 上逾執政：禁中屢火，方醮禳，已罷春宴，仍不御垂拱殿三日。

translations.literal: The emperor went beyond the chief ministers: "Within the Forbidden City fires have recurred repeatedly; we are presently performing ritual prayers for deliverance, have already canceled the spring banquet, and still will not hold court at the Chui'gong Hall for three days."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told his chief ministers, "Fires have broken out again and again within the palace. We are performing rites of supplication, have canceled the spring banquet, and will not hold court at the Chui'gong Hall for three days."

sentences.zh: 四年七月甲子，禁中火。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year, on the jiazi day, fire broke out within the Forbidden City.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the seventh month of the fourth year (1097), fire broke out inside the palace.

sentences.zh: 元符元年四月，宗室宮院火。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Yuanfu, the imperial-clan palace compound caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Yuanfu (1098), the palace compound of the imperial clan burned.

sentences.zh: 建中靖國元年六月壬寅，集禧觀火，大雨中久而後滅。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jianzhong Jingguo, in the sixth month on the renyin day, Jixi Abbey caught fire; amid heavy rain it burned for a long time before it was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the sixth month of the first year of Jianzhong Jingguo (1101), Jixi Abbey caught fire and burned for a long time in pouring rain before it was finally put out.

sentences.zh: 崇寧二年六月，中太乙宮火。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Chongning, the Central Great Ultimate Palace caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of Chongning (1103), the Central Great Ultimate Palace burned.

sentences.zh: 三年三月辛丑，大內火。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year, on the xinchou day, the Great Inner Palace caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the third month of the third year (1104), fire broke out in the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 政和三年四月，蘇州火，延燒公私屋一百七十餘間。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year of Zhenghe, Suzhou had fire; it spread to burn more than one hundred seventy public and private rooms.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year of Zhenghe (1113), Suzhou caught fire, spreading to more than one hundred seventy public and private buildings.

sentences.zh: 五月，封州火，延燒公私屋六百八十二間。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Fengzhou had fire; it spread to burn six hundred eighty-two public and private rooms.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Fengzhou caught fire, spreading to six hundred eighty-two public and private buildings.

sentences.zh: 五月辛丑，京師大盈倉火。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the xinchou day, the Daying Granary in the capital caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the fifth month, the Daying Granary in the capital caught fire.

sentences.zh: 是歲，成都府大慈寺、溫州絳州皆火。

translations.literal: That year, Daci Temple in Chengdu prefecture, and Wenzhou and Jiangzhou all had fire.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Daci Temple in Chengdu, and Wenzhou and Jiangzhou, all suffered fires.

sentences.zh: 重和元年九月，掖庭大火，自甲夜達曉，大雨如傾，火益熾，凡爇五千餘間，後苑廣聖宮及宮人所居幾盡，焚死者甚衆。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Zhonghe, a great fire broke out in the Rear Palace; from the first watch of the night until dawn, rain poured down like overturning, yet the fire burned all the fiercer; altogether more than five thousand rooms were consumed, the Guangshèng Palace of the rear garden and the quarters of palace women were nearly all destroyed, and very many who were burned died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the first year of Zhonghe (1118), a great fire broke out in the Rear Palace. From the first watch until dawn, rain poured in torrents yet the flames only grew; more than five thousand rooms were consumed, the Guangshèng Palace in the rear garden and the women's quarters were nearly all destroyed, and a great many perished in the blaze.

sentences.zh: 靖康元年十二月丙子夜，尚書省火，延燒禮、祠、工、刑、吏部，拆尚書省牌擲火中禳之乃息。

translations.literal: On the night of bingzi in the twelfth month of the first year of Jingkang, the Secretariat caught fire; it spread to burn the Ministries of Rites, Sacrifices, Works, Punishments, and Personnel; the Secretariat placard was dismantled and cast into the fire as a ritual to quell it, and only then did it die out.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of bingzi in the twelfth month of the first year of Jingkang (1126), the Secretariat caught fire and spread through the ministries of Rites, Sacrifices, Works, Punishments, and Personnel; officials tore down the Secretariat placard and cast it into the flames as a ritual offering before the fire finally died out.

sentences.zh: 二年三月戊戌，天漢橋火，焚百餘家。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year, on the wuxu day, Tianhan Bridge caught fire and burned more than a hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the third month of the second year (1127), Tianhan Bridge caught fire and destroyed more than a hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 頃之，都亭驛又火。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter, the Duting post station again caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, the Duting post station burned as well.

sentences.zh: 己酉，保康門火。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the Baokang Gate caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Baokang Gate caught fire.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年十月乙酉，臨安府、越州大火，民多露處。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaoxing, in the tenth month on the yiyou day, great fires struck Lin'an prefecture and Yuezhou; very many common people were left exposed in the open.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the tenth month of the first year of Shaoxing (1131), great fires broke out in Lin'an and Yuezhou, leaving countless people shelterless in the open.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，越州火，焚吏部文書，乙酉，移蹕錢塘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the xinwei day, Yuezhou had fire and burned the documents of the Ministry of Personnel; on yiyou, the imperial procession moved to Qiantang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the twelfth month, Yuezhou caught fire and destroyed the archives of the Ministry of Personnel; on yiyou the court moved its residence to Qiantang.

sentences.zh: 二年正月丁巳，宣州火，燔民居幾半。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, on the dingsi day, Xuanzhou had fire and burned nearly half the dwellings of the people.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the first month of the second year (1132), Xuanzhou caught fire and destroyed nearly half the city's homes.

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰，臨安府大火，亙六七里，燔萬數千家。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the gengchen day, a great fire struck Lin'an prefecture; it stretched six or seven li and burned tens of thousands of households.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the fifth month, a great fire swept Lin'an for six or seven li and destroyed tens of thousands of homes.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，行都大火。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the jiawu day, the traveling capital suffered a great fire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the twelfth month, a great fire broke out in the temporary capital.

sentences.zh: 燔吏刑工部、御史台、官府、民居、軍壘盡，乙未旦乃熄。

translations.literal: It burned the Ministries of Personnel, Punishments, and Works, the Censorate, government offices, common dwellings, and military encampments—all were destroyed; only at dawn on yiwei did it die out.
translations.idiomatic: The blaze consumed the ministries of Personnel, Punishments, and Works, the Censorate, government offices, private homes, and military camps alike, and did not die out until dawn on yiwei.

sentences.zh: 三年九月庚申，行都闕門外火，多燔民居。

translations.literal: In the third year, in the ninth month on the gengshen day, fire broke out outside the Que Gate of the traveling capital and burned very many common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the ninth month of the third year (1133), fire broke out beyond the Que Gate of the temporary capital and destroyed many homes.

sentences.zh: 四年正月戊寅，行都火，燔數千家。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, on the wuyin day, the traveling capital had fire and burned several thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the first month of the fourth year (1134), fire in the temporary capital destroyed several thousand homes.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，行都屢火，燔千餘家。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year, the traveling capital had repeated fires and burned more than a thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the sixth year (1136), fires broke out repeatedly in the temporary capital, destroying more than a thousand homes.

sentences.zh: 十二月，行都大火，燔萬餘家，人有死者。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the traveling capital suffered a great fire; it burned more than ten thousand households, and some people died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, a great fire broke out in the temporary capital, destroying more than ten thousand homes and killing some of the inhabitants.

sentences.zh: 時高宗親征劉豫，都民之暴露者多凍死。

translations.literal: At the time Emperor Gaozong was personally campaigning against Liu Yu; very many among the capital's people who were exposed in the open froze to death.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Emperor Gaozong was personally leading a campaign against Liu Yu, and many residents of the capital who had been left shelterless in the open froze to death.

sentences.zh: 七年正月辛未，平江府火。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, on xinwei in the first month, Pingjiang prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the first month of the seventh year, Pingjiang prefecture caught fire.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，鎮江府、楚、眞、揚、太平州火。

translations.literal: On xinchou in the second month, Zhenjiang prefecture and Chu, Zhen, Yang, and Taiping prefectures caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the second month, Zhenjiang prefecture and the prefectures of Chu, Zhen, Yang, and Taiping all caught fire.

sentences.zh: 是歲，臨安府火。

translations.literal: That year, Lin'an prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: That same year, Lin'an prefecture caught fire.

sentences.zh: 八年二月丁酉，太平府大火，宣撫司及官舍、民居、帑藏、文書皆盡，死者甚衆，錄事參軍呂應中、當塗縣丞李致虛死焉。

translations.literal: On dingyou in the second month of the eighth year, a great fire struck Taiping prefecture; the Pacification Commission, government offices, common dwellings, treasury stores, and documents were all destroyed; very many died, and among them were recording secretary Lü Yingzhong and Dangtu county assistant magistrate Li Zhixu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the second month of the eighth year, a great fire swept Taiping prefecture, destroying the Pacification Commission, government offices, private homes, treasury stores, and every archive on the premises. The dead were very numerous, including recording secretary Lü Yingzhong and Dangtu county assistant magistrate Li Zhixu.

sentences.zh: 九年二月己卯，行都火。

translations.literal: On jimao in the second month of the ninth year, the traveling capital caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the second month of the ninth year, the temporary capital caught fire.

sentences.zh: 七月壬寅，又火。

translations.literal: On renyin in the seventh month, fire broke out again.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the seventh month, fire broke out again.

sentences.zh: 十年十月，行都火，燔民居，延及省部。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the tenth year, the traveling capital caught fire; it burned common dwellings and spread to the provincial ministries.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the tenth year, fire in the temporary capital destroyed private homes and spread to the provincial ministries.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁巳，溫州大火，燔州學、酤征舶等務、永嘉縣治及民居千餘。

translations.literal: On dingsi in the eleventh month, a great fire struck Wenzhou; it burned the prefectural school, the liquor monopoly and merchant-ship tax office, the Yongjia county government offices, and more than a thousand common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the eleventh month, a great fire swept Wenzhou, destroying the prefectural school, the liquor and merchant-ship tax office, the Yongjia county yamen, and more than a thousand private homes.

sentences.zh: 十一年七月癸亥，婺州大火，燔州獄、倉場、寺觀暨民居幾半。

translations.literal: On guihai in the seventh month of the eleventh year, a great fire struck Wuzhou; it burned the prefectural prison, granary yards, temples and monasteries, and nearly half the common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the seventh month of the eleventh year, a great fire swept Wuzhou, consuming the prefectural prison, granary yards, temples and monasteries, and nearly half the city's homes.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，建康府火，燔府治三十余區，民居三千餘家。

translations.literal: On jiayin in the ninth month, Jiankang prefecture caught fire; it burned more than thirty sections of the prefectural government offices and more than three thousand households of common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the ninth month, Jiankang prefecture caught fire, destroying more than thirty sections of the prefectural offices and more than three thousand private homes.

sentences.zh: 十二年二月辛巳，鎮江府火，燔倉米數萬石，芻六萬束，民居尤衆。

translations.literal: On xinsi in the second month of the twelfth year, Zhenjiang prefecture caught fire; it burned tens of thousands of shi of stored grain, sixty thousand bundles of fodder, and a very great number of common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the second month of the twelfth year, Zhenjiang prefecture caught fire, destroying tens of thousands of shi of stored grain, sixty thousand bundles of fodder, and a very great number of private homes.

sentences.zh: 是月，太平、池州及蕪湖縣皆火。

translations.literal: That same month, Taiping, Chizhou, and Wuhu county all caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: That same month, Taiping, Chizhou, and Wuhu county all caught fire.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，行都火。

translations.literal: On bingshen in the third month, the traveling capital caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the third month, the temporary capital caught fire.

sentences.zh: 四月，行都又火。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, the traveling capital caught fire again.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, the temporary capital caught fire again.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月甲子，行都火。

translations.literal: On jiazi in the first month of the fourteenth year, the traveling capital caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the first month of the fourteenth year, the temporary capital caught fire.

sentences.zh: 十五年，大寧監火，燔官舍、帑藏、文書。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, the Daining Directorate caught fire; it burned government offices, treasury stores, and documents.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, the Daining Directorate caught fire, destroying its government offices, treasury stores, and archives.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，行都火，經夕，漸近太室而滅。

translations.literal: On bingzi in the ninth month, the traveling capital caught fire; through the night it burned, gradually approaching the Great Chamber before it died out.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the ninth month, fire broke out in the temporary capital and burned through the night, drawing ever closer to the Great Chamber before it finally died out.

sentences.zh: 十七年八月，建康府火。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the seventeenth year, Jiankang prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the seventeenth year, Jiankang prefecture caught fire.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥，靜江府火，燔民舍甚衆。

translations.literal: On xinhai in the twelfth month, Jingjiang prefecture caught fire and burned a very great number of common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the twelfth month, Jingjiang prefecture caught fire and destroyed a very great number of private homes.

sentences.zh: 二十年正月壬午，行都火，燔吏部文書皆盡。

translations.literal: On renwu in the first month of the twentieth year, the traveling capital caught fire; it burned all the documents of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the first month of the twentieth year, fire in the temporary capital destroyed every archive of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，汴京宮室悉焚。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, the palace halls of Bianjing were entirely burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, the palace halls of Bianjing were entirely consumed by fire.

sentences.zh: 二十六年。

translations.literal: The twenty-sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-sixth year.

sentences.zh: 潭州南嶽廟火。

translations.literal: The Southern Marchmount Temple at Tanzhou caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Marchmount Temple at Tanzhou caught fire.

sentences.zh: 二十九年四月，鎮江府火，焚軍壘、民居。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-ninth year, Zhenjiang prefecture caught fire and burned military encampments and common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twenty-ninth year, Zhenjiang prefecture caught fire, destroying military camps and private homes.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子，夔州大火，燔官舍、民居、寺觀，人有死者。

translations.literal: On bingzi in the twelfth month, a great fire struck Kuizhou; it burned government offices, common dwellings, and temples and monasteries, and some people died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the twelfth month, a great fire swept Kuizhou, destroying government offices, private homes, and temples and monasteries, and some people perished.

sentences.zh: 乾道元年正月，泰州火，燔民舍幾盡。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Qiandao, Taizhou caught fire and burned nearly all common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Qiandao, Taizhou caught fire and nearly all private homes were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 是年春，德安府應城縣廄驛火。

translations.literal: That spring, the relay station stables at Yingcheng county in De'an prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: That spring, the relay station stables at Yingcheng county in De'an prefecture caught fire.

sentences.zh: 二年冬，眞州六合縣武鋒軍壘火。

translations.literal: In the winter of the second year, the Wufeng Army camp at Liuhe county in Zhen prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the second year, the Wufeng Army camp at Liuhe county in Zhen prefecture caught fire.

sentences.zh: 十二月，婺州火。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Wuzhou caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Wuzhou caught fire.

sentences.zh: 自是火患不息，人火之也。

translations.literal: From this time fire calamities never ceased—it was human-caused fire.
translations.idiomatic: From this time fires never ceased, for they were caused by human agency.

sentences.zh: 三年五月，泉州火。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the third year, Quanzhou caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the third year, Quanzhou caught fire.

sentences.zh: 五年十二月壬申，太室東北垣外民舍火。

translations.literal: On renshen in the twelfth month of the fifth year, common dwellings outside the northeastern wall of the Great Chamber caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the twelfth month of the fifth year, fire broke out among private homes outside the northeastern wall of the Great Chamber.

sentences.zh: 七年十一月丁亥，禁垣外閹人私舍火，延及民居。

translations.literal: On dinghai in the eleventh month of the seventh year, private dwellings of eunuchs outside the forbidden walls caught fire and spread to common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the eleventh month of the seventh year, fire broke out at private homes of eunuchs beyond the palace walls and spread to private dwellings.

sentences.zh: 九年九月，台州火，經夕，至於翌日晝漏半，燔州獄、縣治、酒務及居民七千余家。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the ninth year, Taizhou caught fire; through the night, until half the daytime water-clock of the next day, it burned the prefectural prison, county government offices, liquor monopoly office, and more than seven thousand households of residents.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the ninth year, Taizhou caught fire and burned through the night until midday of the following day, destroying the prefectural prison, county yamen, liquor monopoly office, and more than seven thousand homes.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年十二月丁巳，泉州火，燔城樓及五十餘家。

translations.literal: On dingsi in the twelfth month of the first year of Chunxi, Quanzhou caught fire; it burned the city gate tower and more than fifty households.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the twelfth month of the first year of Chunxi, Quanzhou caught fire, destroying the city gate tower and more than fifty homes.

sentences.zh: 二年六月戊午，潭州南嶽廟火。

translations.literal: On wuwu in the sixth month of the second year, the Southern Marchmount Temple at Tanzhou caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the sixth month of the second year, the Southern Marchmount Temple at Tanzhou caught fire.

sentences.zh: 八月，嚴州火。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Yan prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Yan prefecture caught fire.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸亥，麗正門內東廡災。

translations.literal: On guihai in the eleventh month, disaster struck the eastern gallery inside the Lizheng Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the eleventh month, the eastern gallery inside the Lizheng Gate was destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 是歲，瀘州火，坐上焚民居不實，守臣貶秩。

translations.literal: That year, Luzhou caught fire; for a false report on burned common dwellings the presiding official was demoted in rank.
translations.idiomatic: That year Luzhou caught fire, and the local official was demoted for falsely reporting the extent of damage to private homes.

sentences.zh: 三年九月，大內射殿災，延及東宮門。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the third year, disaster struck the archery hall within the inner palace and spread to the Eastern Palace Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the third year, the archery hall within the inner palace caught fire and spread to the Eastern Palace Gate.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月辛酉，鄂州南市火，暴風通夕，燔千餘家。

translations.literal: On xinyou in the eleventh month of the fourth year, the southern market at Ezhou caught fire; a violent wind blew through the night and burned more than a thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the eleventh month of the fourth year, fire broke out in the southern market at Ezhou; a violent wind blew all night and destroyed more than a thousand homes.

sentences.zh: 五年四月庚寅，興州沙市火，燔三百四十餘家，有死者。

translations.literal: On gengyin in the fourth month of the fifth year, the sand market at Xing prefecture caught fire; it burned more than three hundred forty households, and some died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the fourth month of the fifth year, the sand market at Xing prefecture caught fire, destroying more than three hundred forty homes and killing some of the inhabitants.

sentences.zh: 十一月，和州牧營火，燔一百六十區。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the pasturage camp at He prefecture caught fire and burned one hundred sixty sections.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the pasturage camp at He prefecture caught fire and destroyed one hundred sixty compounds.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，江陵府沙市大火，燔數千家，延及船艦，死者甚衆。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year, a great fire struck the sand market in Jiangling prefecture; it burned several thousand households, spread to ships, and very many died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year, a great fire swept the sand market in Jiangling prefecture, destroying several thousand homes, spreading to the boats moored there, and killing very many people.

sentences.zh: 八月，溫州試士，火作于貢闈。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, during the Wenzhou examination for scholars, fire broke out in the examination hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, while Wenzhou was examining candidates for office, fire broke out in the examination hall.

sentences.zh: 八年正月，揚州火。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year, Yangzhou caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year, Yangzhou caught fire.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，行都火。

translations.literal: On yihai in the ninth month, the traveling capital caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the ninth month, the temporary capital caught fire.

sentences.zh: 九年九月，合州大火。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the ninth year, a great fire struck He prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the ninth year, a great fire broke out in He prefecture.

sentences.zh: 燔民居幾盡，官舍僅有存者。

translations.literal: It burned nearly all common dwellings; of government offices only a few remained.
translations.idiomatic: Private homes were nearly all destroyed, and only a few government offices were spared.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月辛酉，興元府義勝軍壘舍火。

translations.literal: On xinyou in the second month of the eleventh year, the Yisheng Army barracks at Xingyuan prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the second month of the eleventh year, the Yisheng Army barracks at Xingyuan prefecture caught fire.

sentences.zh: 十二年八月，溫州火，燔城樓及四百餘家。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twelfth year, Wenzhou caught fire; it burned the city gate tower and more than four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twelfth year, Wenzhou caught fire, destroying the city gate tower and more than four hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 十月，鄂州大火，燔萬餘家。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, a great fire struck Ezhou and burned more than ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, a great fire swept Ezhou and destroyed more than ten thousand homes.

sentences.zh: 江風暴作，結廬堤上、泊舟岸下者，焚溺無遺。

translations.literal: A violent river wind arose; those who had built shelters on the embankment and moored boats below the shore were burned and drowned with nothing left.
translations.idiomatic: A violent wind blew up on the river, and those who had pitched shelters on the embankment or moored boats below the shore were burned or drowned without a trace.

sentences.zh: 十四年五月，大內武庫災，戎器不害。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourteenth year, disaster struck the armory within the inner palace; weapons of war were not harmed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourteenth year, the armory within the inner palace caught fire, but the weapons of war were not harmed.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅，行都寶蓮山民居火，延燒七百餘家，救焚將校有死者。

translations.literal: On gengyin in the sixth month, fire broke out among common dwellings at Baolian Mountain in the traveling capital; the blaze spread to burn more than seven hundred households, and some officers and soldiers who fought the fire died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the sixth month, fire broke out among private homes at Baolian Mountain in the temporary capital, spread to destroy more than seven hundred homes, and killed some of the officers and soldiers who fought the blaze.

sentences.zh: 五月，成都府市火，燔萬餘家。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the market at Chengdu prefecture caught fire and burned more than ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, fire broke out in the market at Chengdu prefecture and destroyed more than ten thousand homes.

sentences.zh: 十六年九月，南劍州大火，民居存者無幾。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the sixteenth year, a great fire struck Nanjian prefecture; few common dwellings remained.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the sixteenth year, a great fire swept Nanjian prefecture, and few private homes were left standing.

sentences.zh: 紹熙元年八月壬寅，處州火，燔數百家。

translations.literal: On renyin in the eighth month of the first year of Shaoxi, Chuzhou caught fire and burned several hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the eighth month of the first year of Shaoxi, Chuzhou caught fire and destroyed several hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，建寧府浦城縣火。

translations.literal: On wushen in the twelfth month, Pucheng county in Jianning prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the twelfth month, Pucheng county in Jianning prefecture caught fire.

sentences.zh: 時查洞寇張海作亂，焚五百餘家。

translations.literal: At the time the Chadong bandit Zhang Hai was in rebellion and burned more than five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Chadong bandit Zhang Hai was in rebellion and burned more than five hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，行都傳法寺火，延及民居。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year, the Dharma-transmission Temple in the traveling capital caught fire and spread to common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year, the Dharma-transmission Temple in the temporary capital caught fire and spread to private homes.

sentences.zh: 言者以戚里土木爲孽，火數起之應。

translations.literal: Memorialists held that construction by the imperial in-laws was the evil cause and the reason fires repeatedly arose.
translations.idiomatic: Memorialists argued that building projects undertaken by the imperial in-laws were an evil cause and the reason fires kept breaking out.

sentences.zh: 是月，徽州大火，夜燔州治、譙樓、官舍、獄宇、錢帑庫務，凡十有九所，五百二十余區，延燒千五百家，自庚子至於壬寅乃熄。

translations.literal: That same month, a great fire struck Huizhou; by night it burned the prefectural government offices, gate tower, government offices, prisons, coin and treasury yards—in nineteen sites totaling more than five hundred twenty sections—and spread to burn fifteen hundred households, not dying out from gengzi until renyin.
translations.idiomatic: That same month, a great fire swept Huizhou. By night it had destroyed the prefectural offices, gate tower, government offices, prisons, and coin and treasury yards—nineteen sites in all, more than five hundred twenty compounds—and spread to burn fifteen hundred homes before it finally died out between gengzi and renyin.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，金州火，燔州治、官舍、帑藏、保勝軍器庫、城內外民居甚衆。

translations.literal: On jisi in the fifth month, Jin prefecture caught fire; it burned the prefectural government offices, government offices, treasury stores, the Baosheng armory, and a very great number of common dwellings inside and outside the city.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the fifth month, Jin prefecture caught fire, destroying the prefectural offices, government offices, treasury stores, the Baosheng armory, and a very great number of private homes inside and outside the city.

sentences.zh: 三年正月己巳，行都火，通夕，至於翌日，闤闠焚者半。

translations.literal: On jisi in the first month of the third year, the traveling capital caught fire; through the night, until the next day, half the markets and shops were burned.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the first month of the third year, fire broke out in the temporary capital and burned through the night into the next day, destroying half the markets and shops.

sentences.zh: 十一月，又火，燔五百餘家。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, fire broke out again and burned more than five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, fire broke out again and destroyed more than five hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，鄂州火，至於翌日，燔八百家。

translations.literal: On jiachen in the twelfth month, Ezhou caught fire; into the next day it burned eight hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the twelfth month, Ezhou caught fire and burned into the next day, destroying eight hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 慶元二年八月己酉，永州火，燔三百家。

translations.literal: On jiyou in the eighth month of the second year of Qingyuan, Yongzhou caught fire and burned three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the eighth month of the second year of Qingyuan, Yongzhou caught fire and destroyed three hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 三年閏月甲申，金州都統司中軍壘舍火，焚千三百余區。

translations.literal: On jiashen in the intercalary month of the third year, the central army barracks of the Jin prefecture Commandant's office caught fire and burned more than thirteen hundred sections.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the intercalary month of the third year, the central army barracks of the Jin prefecture Commandant's office caught fire and destroyed more than thirteen hundred compounds.

sentences.zh: 閱六月乙酉，又火。

translations.literal: On yiyou in the sixth intercalary month, fire broke out again.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the sixth intercalary month, fire broke out again.

sentences.zh: 燔二千余區。

translations.literal: It burned more than two thousand sections.
translations.idiomatic: It destroyed more than two thousand compounds.

sentences.zh: 是冬，紹興府僧寺火，延燒數百家。

translations.literal: That winter, a Buddhist monastery in Shaoxing prefecture caught fire and spread to burn several hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, a Buddhist monastery in Shaoxing prefecture caught fire and spread to destroy several hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 六年八月戊戌，徽州火。

translations.literal: On wuxu in the eighth month of the sixth year, Huizhou caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the eighth month of the sixth year, Huizhou caught fire.

sentences.zh: 燔州獄、官舍，延及八百餘家。

translations.literal: It burned the prefectural prison and government offices and spread to more than eight hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: It destroyed the prefectural prison and government offices and spread to more than eight hundred private homes.

sentences.zh: 嘉定元年三月戊寅，行都大火，至於四月辛巳，燔御史台、司農寺、將作軍器監、進奏文思御輦院、太史局、軍頭皇城司、法物庫、御廚、班直諸軍壘，延燒五萬八千九十七家。

translations.literal: On wuyin in the third month of the first year of Jiading, a great fire struck the traveling capital; lasting until xinsi in the fourth month, it burned the Censorate, Ministry of Revenue, Directorate of Palace Maintenance and Armory, Memorial Transmission and Literary Refinement and Imperial Chariot Directorate, Astronomical Bureau, Army Head and Imperial City Office, ritual objects depot, imperial kitchen, and duty-shift military encampments, spreading to burn fifty-eight thousand ninety-seven households.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the third month of the first year of Jiading, a great fire broke out in the temporary capital and burned until xinsi in the fourth month, destroying the Censorate, Ministry of Revenue, Directorate of Palace Maintenance and Armory, Memorial Transmission and Literary Refinement and Imperial Chariot Directorate, Astronomical Bureau, Army Head and Imperial City Office, ritual objects depot, imperial kitchen, and duty-shift military camps, and spreading to destroy fifty-eight thousand ninety-seven homes.

sentences.zh: 城內外亙十余里，死者五十有九人，踐死者不可計。

translations.literal: Inside and outside the city it stretched more than ten li; fifty-nine people died, and those trampled to death were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Inside and outside the city the blaze stretched more than ten li. Fifty-nine people died in the fire, and those trampled to death in the panic were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 城中廬舍九毀其七，百官多僦舟以居。

translations.literal: Nine-tenths of the city's lodgings were destroyed; very many officials rented boats to dwell in.
translations.idiomatic: Seven tenths of the dwellings in the city were destroyed, and many officials took to renting boats for shelter.

sentences.zh: 火作於寶蓮山御史台胥楊浩家，諫議大夫程松請戮浩以謝都民。

translations.literal: The fire originated at the home of the Censorate clerk Yang Hao on Baolian Mountain; remonstrance official Cheng Song requested that Hao be executed to appease the capital's people.
translations.idiomatic: The fire had started at the home of Censorate clerk Yang Hao on Baolian Mountain, and remonstrance official Cheng Song asked that Hao be put to death to appease the people of the capital.

sentences.zh: 疏再上，始黥配萬安軍，猶免決。

translations.literal: After memorials were submitted again, he was finally tattooed and exiled to Wan'an Army, yet even corporal punishment was waived.
translations.idiomatic: Only after further memorials were submitted was Hao finally tattooed and exiled to Wan'an Army, and even then he was spared the beating.

sentences.zh: 自是民訛言相驚，亡賴因縱火爲奸利。

translations.literal: From this time the people passed alarming rumors among themselves, and ruffians took advantage by setting fires for illicit profit.
translations.idiomatic: From this time alarming rumors spread among the people, and ruffians took advantage of the panic by setting fires for illicit profit.

sentences.zh: 二年六月己卯，臨安府火。

translations.literal: On jimao in the sixth month of the second year, Lin'an prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the sixth month of the second year, Lin'an prefecture caught fire.

sentences.zh: 三年正月丁酉，襄陽府火作而風暴，選鋒軍校于友直死于救焚，止延燒六十餘家。

translations.literal: On dingyou in the first month of the third year, fire broke out in Xiangyang prefecture amid a violent wind; Xuanfeng Army officer Yu Youzhi died fighting the blaze, and in the end only about sixty households were consumed in the spread of the fire.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the first month of the third year, fire broke out in Xiangyang prefecture as a violent wind rose. Xuanfeng Army officer Yu Youzhi died fighting the blaze, and in the end the fire spread to only about sixty homes.

sentences.zh: 帥、漕臣上其功，贈二秩，官其子二。

translations.literal: The military commissioner and transport commissioner memorialized his merit; he was posthumously promoted two ranks, and two of his sons were given office.
translations.idiomatic: The military commissioner and transport commissioner memorialized his merit, and the court posthumously promoted him two ranks and granted office to two of his sons.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，福州火。

translations.literal: On jiawu in the eleventh month, Fuzhou caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the eleventh month, Fuzhou caught fire.

sentences.zh: 燔四百餘家。

translations.literal: It burned more than four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: It destroyed more than four hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 四年三月丁卯，行都大火，燔尚書中書省、樞密院、六部、右丞相府、制敕糧料院、親兵營、修內司，延及學士院、內酒庫、內宮門廡，夜召禁旅救撲。

translations.literal: On dingmao in the third month of the fourth year, a great fire struck the traveling capital; it burned the Secretariat-Chancellery, Bureau of Military Affairs, Six Ministries, right grand councilor's residence, Edict and Ration Grain Office, personal guard camp, and Directorate of Palace Maintenance, spreading to the Academy of Scholarly Worthies, inner liquor depot, and inner palace gate galleries, and at night the palace guard was summoned to fight the blaze.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the third month of the fourth year, a great fire broke out in the temporary capital, destroying the Secretariat-Chancellery, Bureau of Military Affairs, Six Ministries, the right grand councilor's residence, the Edict and Ration Grain Office, the personal guard camp, and the Directorate of Palace Maintenance, and spreading to the Academy of Scholarly Worthies, the inner liquor depot, and the inner palace gate galleries. That night the palace guard was summoned to fight the blaze.

sentences.zh: 太室撤廟廡，遷神主並冊、寶于壽慈宮。

translations.literal: The Great Chamber dismantled its temple galleries and moved the spirit tablets together with the regalia scrolls and seal to Shouci Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Chamber dismantled its temple galleries and moved the spirit tablets, together with the regalia scrolls and imperial seal, to Shouci Palace.

sentences.zh: 翼日戊辰旦，火及和寧門鴟吻，禁卒張隆飛梯斧之，門以不焚。

translations.literal: At dawn on wuchen the next day, the fire reached the owl-tail ornament of He'ning Gate; palace guard Zhang Long flew up a ladder and chopped it away, so the gate was not burned.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn on wuchen the following day, the fire reached the roof-ridge ornament of He'ning Gate. Palace guard Zhang Long climbed a flying ladder and chopped it away, so the gate itself was not burned.

sentences.zh: 火作時，分數道，燔二千七十餘家。

translations.literal: When the fire broke out, it divided into several paths and burned more than two thousand seventy households.
translations.idiomatic: When the fire broke out, it divided into several paths and destroyed more than two thousand seventy homes.

sentences.zh: 又翌日己巳，神主還太室。

translations.literal: Again on the next day, jisi, the spirit tablets returned to the Great Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the day after that, the spirit tablets were returned to the Great Chamber.

sentences.zh: 時省部皆寓治驛、寺。

translations.literal: At the time the provincial ministries were all lodged for governance at relay stations and temples.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the provincial ministries were all conducting affairs from relay stations and temples.

sentences.zh: 四月丙申，臨安府梵天寺火。

translations.literal: On bingshen in the fourth month, Fantian Temple in Lin'an prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the fourth month, Fantian Temple in Lin'an prefecture caught fire.

sentences.zh: 六月，盱眙軍天長縣禁軍營火，鎧械爲盡。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the forbidden-army camp at Tianchang county in Xuyi Army caught fire; armor and weapons were entirely destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the palace army camp at Tianchang county in Xuyi Army caught fire, and every piece of armor and weaponry was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，鄂州外南市火，燔五百餘家。

translations.literal: On renchen in the eighth month, the outer southern market at Ezhou caught fire and burned more than five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the eighth month, fire broke out in the outer southern market at Ezhou and destroyed more than five hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 開禧二年二月癸丑，壽慈宮災。

translations.literal: On guichou in the second month of the second year of Kaixi, disaster struck Shouci Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the second month of the second year of Kaixi, Shouci Palace was destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 四月壬子，行都火，燔數百家。

translations.literal: On renzi in the fourth month, the traveling capital caught fire and burned several hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the fourth month, fire in the temporary capital destroyed several hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 嘉定二年八月己巳，信州火，燔二百家。

translations.literal: On jisi in the eighth month of the second year of Jiading, Xin prefecture caught fire and burned two hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the eighth month of the second year of Jiading, Xin prefecture caught fire and destroyed two hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，吉州火，燔五百餘家。

translations.literal: On dingyou in the ninth month, Ji prefecture caught fire and burned more than five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the ninth month, Ji prefecture caught fire and destroyed more than five hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 是歲，瀘州火，燔千餘家。

translations.literal: That year, Luzhou had fire; it burned more than a thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: That same year, Luzhou caught fire and destroyed more than a thousand homes.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，建寧府政和縣火，燔百餘家。

translations.literal: On dinghai in the eleventh month, Zhenghe county in Jianning prefecture had fire; it burned more than a hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the eleventh month, fire broke out in Zhenghe county, Jianning prefecture, and destroyed more than a hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 四年閏二月己卯，紹興府嵊縣浦橋火，燔百餘家。

translations.literal: On jimao in the intercalary second month of the fourth year, Puqiao in Sheng county, Shaoxing prefecture had fire; it burned more than a hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the intercalary second month of the fourth year, fire at Puqiao in Sheng county, Shaoxing prefecture, destroyed more than a hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 三月，滁州火，燔民居甚多。

translations.literal: In the third month, Chuzhou had fire; it burned very many common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Chuzhou caught fire and destroyed a great many private homes.

sentences.zh: 十月，撫州火。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Fuzhou had fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Fuzhou caught fire.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，福州一夕再火，燔城門、僧寺，延燒千余家，死者數人。

translations.literal: On xinmao, in one night Fuzhou had fire twice; it burned the city gates and Buddhist temples, spread to burn more than a thousand households, and several people died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Fuzhou caught fire twice in a single night, destroying the city gates and Buddhist temples, spreading to burn more than a thousand homes and killing several people.

sentences.zh: 五年五月己未，和州火。

translations.literal: On jiwei in the fifth month of the fifth year, He prefecture had fire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the fifth month of the fifth year, He prefecture caught fire.

sentences.zh: 燔二千家。

translations.literal: It burned two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: The blaze destroyed two thousand homes.

sentences.zh: 八年八月辛丑，湖州火，燔寺觀，延燒三百家。

translations.literal: On xinchou in the eighth month of the eighth year, Huzhou had fire; it burned temples and shrines and spread to burn three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the eighth month of the eighth year, Huzhou caught fire, destroying temples and shrines and spreading to burn three hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 九年七月甲戌，南劍州沙縣火，燔縣門、官舍及千一百餘家，民有死者。

translations.literal: On jiaxu in the seventh month of the ninth year, Shaxian in Nanjian prefecture had fire; it burned the county gate, government offices, and more than eleven hundred households, and some commoners died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the seventh month of the ninth year, fire broke out in Shaxian, Nanjian prefecture, destroying the county gate, government offices, and more than eleven hundred homes; some of the inhabitants perished.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月，行都火。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eleventh year, the traveling capital had fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eleventh year, the temporary capital caught fire.

sentences.zh: 燔數百家。

translations.literal: It burned several hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: The blaze destroyed several hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，禁垣外萬松嶺民舍火，燔四百八十餘家。

translations.literal: On jisi in the ninth month, common dwellings outside the forbidden enclosure at Wansong Ridge had fire; it burned more than four hundred eighty households.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the ninth month, fire broke out among the common dwellings outside the forbidden enclosure at Wansong Ridge and destroyed more than four hundred eighty homes.

sentences.zh: 十三年二月庚寅，安豐軍故步鎮火，燔千余家，死者五十余人。

translations.literal: On gengyin in the second month of the thirteenth year, Gubu garrison in Anfeng army had fire; it burned more than a thousand households, and more than fifty people died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the second month of the thirteenth year, fire swept Gubu garrison in Anfeng army, destroying more than a thousand homes and killing more than fifty people.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，慶元府火，燔官舍、第宅、寺觀、民居甚衆。

translations.literal: On gengwu in the eighth month, Qingyuan prefecture had fire; it burned government offices, mansions, temples and shrines, and very many common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the eighth month, Qingyuan prefecture caught fire, destroying government offices, mansions, temples and shrines, and a great many private homes.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，行都火，燔城內外數萬家、禁壘百二十區。

translations.literal: On renzi in the eleventh month, the traveling capital had fire; it burned tens of thousands of households inside and outside the city and one hundred twenty sections of the forbidden ramparts.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the eleventh month, fire broke out in the temporary capital, destroying tens of thousands of homes inside and outside the city walls and one hundred twenty sections of the forbidden ramparts.

sentences.zh: 十七年四月丁卯，西和州焚軍壘及民居二千餘家，人火之也。

translations.literal: On dingmao in the fourth month of the seventeenth year, Xihe prefecture burned military ramparts and more than two thousand common dwellings—it was man-made fire.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the fourth month of the seventeenth year, military ramparts and more than two thousand private homes at Xihe prefecture were burned in a fire caused by human agency.

sentences.zh: 守臣尚震午誤以爲金人至而遁。

translations.literal: The defending official Shang Zhenwu mistakenly thought the Jurchens had arrived and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The defending official Shang Zhenwu, mistaking the blaze for a Jurchen attack, fled.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，岳州火，燔岳陽樓、州獄、帑庫，延及八十家。

translations.literal: On dinghai in the sixth month, Yue prefecture had fire; it burned Yueyang Tower, the prefectural prison, and the treasury, and spread to eighty households.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the sixth month, Yue prefecture caught fire, destroying Yueyang Tower, the prefectural prison, and the treasury, and spreading to eighty homes.

sentences.zh: 己丑又火，燔百餘家。

translations.literal: On jichou fire broke out again and burned more than a hundred households.

translations.idiomatic: That winter of the fourth year, the capital saw no snow.

translations.literal: In the winter of the fifth year, there was no snow or ice.
translations.idiomatic: That winter of the fifth year brought neither snow nor ice.

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year of Shaoxing, great oppressive heat lasted more than forty days; grass and trees were scorched dry, rocks burned people, and very many died of heatstroke.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifth year of Shaoxing, oppressive heat endured for more than forty days; grass and trees withered to ash, rocks scorched anyone who touched them, and very many people died of heatstroke.

sentences.zh: 三十一年冬，無雪。

translations.literal: In the winter of the thirty-first year, there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter of the thirty-first year brought no snow.

translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Qiandao, the winter was warm, with little snow and no ice.

sentences.zh: 五年，冬溫，無雪。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the winter was warm and there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, the winter was warm and brought no snow.

sentences.zh: 六年，冬溫，無雪冰。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the winter was warm, with no snow or ice.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, the winter was warm and brought neither snow nor ice.

translations.idiomatic: That winter of the third year of Shaoxi, Tongchuan circuit received no rain; the air hung oppressively hot as in midsummer, sun and moon both turned red, and Rong prefecture suffered most severely.

sentences.zh: 六年，冬燠無雪，桃李華，蟲不蟄。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the winter was oppressively hot with no snow; peach and plum trees blossomed, and insects did not hibernate.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, the winter hung oppressively hot and brought no snow; peach and plum trees bloomed, and insects failed to hibernate.

sentences.zh: 開禧三年冬，少雪。

translations.literal: In the winter of the third year of Kaixi, there was little snow.

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiading, spring was oppressively hot like summer.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiading, spring was as oppressively hot as summer.

sentences.zh: 六年冬，燠而雷，無冰，蟲不蟄。

translations.literal: In the winter of the sixth year, it was oppressively hot and thunder sounded; there was no ice, and insects did not hibernate.
translations.idiomatic: That winter of the sixth year hung oppressively hot and thunder rolled; no ice formed, and insects failed to hibernate.

sentences.zh: 八年夏五月，大燠，草木枯槁，百泉皆竭，行都斛水百錢，江、淮杯水數十錢，暍死者甚衆。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer of the eighth year, there was great oppressive heat; grass and trees withered dry, every spring ran dry, a hu of water in the traveling capital cost a hundred cash, a cup of water on the Yangzi and Huai cost several tens of cash, and very many died of heatstroke.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year, oppressive heat scorched the land; grass and trees withered, every spring ran dry, a hu of water in the temporary capital sold for a hundred cash, a cup of water along the Yangzi and Huai for several tens of cash, and very many people died of heatstroke.

sentences.zh: 九年冬，無雪。

translations.literal: In the winter of the ninth year, there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter of the ninth year brought no snow.

sentences.zh: 十三年冬，無冰雪。

translations.literal: In the winter of the thirteenth year, there was no snow or ice.
translations.idiomatic: That winter of the thirteenth year brought neither snow nor ice.

sentences.zh: 越歲，春暴燠，土燥泉竭。

translations.literal: The year after, in spring there was sudden oppressive heat; the soil was dry and springs ran dry.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, spring brought sudden oppressive heat; the soil dried and springs failed.

sentences.zh: 建隆二年九月，亳州獻芝一株。

translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of Jianlong, Bozhou presented one stalk of lingzhi as tribute.

translations.literal: In the intercalary eighth month of the fourth year of Qiande, commoner Duan Zan of Huanggang county had purple lingzhi grow on a house pillar—one plant with two stems; prefect Zheng Shouzhong presented it as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eighth month of the fourth year of Qiande, purple lingzhi sprouted on a house pillar belonging to Duan Zan, a commoner of Huanggang county, one plant bearing two stems; Prefect Zheng Shouzhong presented it as tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月，登州獻芝五莖。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Deng prefecture presented five stalks of lingzhi as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Deng prefecture presented five stalks of lingzhi as tribute.

sentences.zh: 開寶四年，成都府民羅達家生芝。

translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Kaibao, lingzhi appeared at the home of Luo Da, a commoner of Chengdu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，知梓州趙延通獻芝一本。

translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year, Zhao Yantong, prefect of Zizhou, presented one plant of lingzhi as tribute.

translations.idiomatic: Lingzhi sprouted in the hall of Daming Abbey in Hezhong prefecture, and Military Commissioner Chen Siliang reported the prodigy.

sentences.zh: 七年七月，陳州節度黨進獻控鶴營卒孫洪家芝二本。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the seventh year, Chenzhou Military Commissioner Dang Jin presented two plants of lingzhi from the home of Sun Hong, a soldier of the Crane-Control Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the seventh year, Chenzhou Military Commissioner Dang Jin presented two plants of lingzhi from the home of Sun Hong, a soldier of the Crane-Control Garrison.

translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, he again presented one plant of lingzhi bearing forty-nine stalks.

translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, lingzhi sprouted on a pillar of the Macheng county yamen, and Prefect Wang Ming presented it as tribute.

translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Zizhou presented lingzhi as tribute.

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year, Wang Yuanzheng, magistrate of Xiangcheng county, presented lingzhi as tribute.

translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Guangzhou presented lingzhi as tribute.

translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year, Guangzhou presented lingzhi as tribute.
