translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Mount Hua Daoist Ding Shaowei presented one vessel of white lingzhi and one vessel of dark lingzhi.

translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, lingzhi sprouted on a beam of the traveling-palace hall in Zhending prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, a bamboo stalk in Zhao Feng village, Xinjin county, bore twelve nodes and forked into two branches at the top; Prefect Cui Xian reported the prodigy.

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventh year, Pei Renfeng, prefect of Huangzhou, presented lingzhi as tribute.

translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Chen Tan, magistrate of Luojiang county, gathered four plants of lingzhi on Mount Luojun and presented them as tribute.

translations.idiomatic: At the pine roots of Wanshou Temple in Xiangyin county, two plants of lingzhi sprouted, and Transport Vice-Commissioner Zhao Chang presented them as tribute.

translations.idiomatic: Three plants of lingzhi appeared in the gardens of Ouyang Jin and Xiahou Min, commoners of Tan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宜興縣民長孫裕家生芝，紫莖黃蓋。

translations.idiomatic: Lingzhi sprouted at the home of Zhangsun Yu, a commoner of Yixing county, with purple stems and yellow caps.

translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighth year, He Yunzhao, prefect of Fuzhou, presented two plants of lingzhi as tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月，漢州獻芝。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Han prefecture presented lingzhi as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Han prefecture presented lingzhi as tribute.

sentences.zh: 十月乙酉，蜀州獻瑞竹一本十六節，上分兩枝。

translations.literal: On yiyou in the tenth month, Shuzhou presented one auspicious bamboo stalk of sixteen nodes that forked into two branches at the top.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the tenth month, Shuzhou presented one auspicious bamboo stalk of sixteen nodes that forked into two branches at the top.

sentences.zh: 知連州史昭文獻芝二莖。

translations.idiomatic: Shi Zhaowen, prefect of Lian prefecture, presented two stalks of lingzhi as tribute.

translations.idiomatic: Three plants of lingzhi sprouted at the military supervisor's yamen in Jin prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the ninth year, Jin prefecture presented three plants of lingzhi as tribute and Yongkang army presented nine stalks of lingzhi as tribute; both offerings reached the court on the same day.

translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Shen Hu, prefect of Zizhou, obtained three stalks of lingzhi.

translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, peonies at the home of Song Qi, Minister of Justice, bore three blossoms.

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Duangong, Hao Zheng, prefect of Xiang prefecture, presented five plants of lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Duangong, Hao Zheng, prefect of Xiang prefecture, presented five plants of lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 八月，廣州鳳集合歡樹下，得芝三本。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, phoenixes gathered beneath a silk tree in Guang prefecture, and three plants of lingzhi were obtained there.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, phoenixes gathered beneath a silk tree in Guang prefecture, where three plants of lingzhi were found.

sentences.zh: 二年七月，彭山縣民家生異竹。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year, anomalous bamboo sprouted at a commoner's home in Pengshan county.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year, anomalous bamboo sprouted at a commoner's home in Pengshan county.

sentences.zh: 舒州芝草生，知州趙孚以獻。

translations.literal: Lingzhi grass sprouted in Shu prefecture; Prefect Zhao Fu presented it as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhi grass sprouted in Shu prefecture, and Prefect Zhao Fu presented it as tribute.

sentences.zh: 十月，密州獻芝草。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Mi prefecture presented lingzhi grass as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Mi prefecture presented lingzhi grass as tribute.

sentences.zh: 淳化元年四月，永州監軍廨芝草生，知州克憲以聞。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Chunhua, lingzhi grass sprouted at the military supervisor's yamen in Yong prefecture; Prefect Ke Xian reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Chunhua, lingzhi grass sprouted at the military supervisor's yamen in Yong prefecture, and Prefect Ke Xian reported it to the court.

sentences.zh: 八月，黃州刺史魏丕獻芝草。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Wei Pi, prefect of Huang prefecture, presented lingzhi grass as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Wei Pi, prefect of Huang prefecture, presented lingzhi grass as tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年二月，射洪縣安國寺竹二莖同本。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year, at Anguo Temple in Shehong county, two bamboo stalks shared a single root.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year, at Anguo Temple in Shehong county, two bamboo stalks grew from a single root.

sentences.zh: 六月，舒州竹連理，知州樂史以聞。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, conjoined bamboo appeared in Shu prefecture; Prefect Yue Shi reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, conjoined bamboo appeared in Shu prefecture, and Prefect Yue Shi reported it to the court.

sentences.zh: 十一月，陵州民趙崇家慈竹二莖，長六尺許，其上別有根柢，莖分十枝，長丈餘；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, at the home of Zhao Chong, a commoner of Ling prefecture, two stalks of sweet bamboo about six feet in height had separate roots and bases above them; the stalks split into ten branches more than a ten-foot length long;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, at the home of Zhao Chong, a commoner of Ling prefecture, two stalks of sweet bamboo about six feet tall bore separate roots and bases above them, then split into ten branches more than ten feet long;

sentences.zh: 又一本三莖並聳。

translations.literal: Another plant had three stalks rising together side by side.
translations.idiomatic: Another plant had three stalks rising together from the same base.

sentences.zh: 三年十月，朗州異竹生。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year, anomalous bamboo sprouted in Lang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the third year, anomalous bamboo sprouted in Lang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 京師太平興國寺牡丹生華，占云：「有喪。」

translations.literal: At Taiping Xingguo Temple in the capital, peonies bloomed; divination said: "There will be a bereavement."
translations.idiomatic: At Taiping Xingguo Temple in the capital, peonies bloomed, and divination read the sign as: "There will be a bereavement."

sentences.zh: 是月，恭孝太子薨。

translations.literal: That same month, the Filial and Respectful Crown Prince died.
translations.idiomatic: That same month, the Filial and Respectful Crown Prince died.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，知興化軍馮亮獻芝草。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, Feng Liang, military commissioner of Xinghua Army, presented lingzhi grass as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, Feng Liang, military commissioner of Xinghua Army, presented lingzhi grass as tribute.

sentences.zh: 十月，彭門芝草生。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, lingzhi grass sprouted at Pengmen.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, lingzhi grass sprouted at Pengmen.

sentences.zh: 十二月，榮州獻《異竹圖》。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Rong prefecture presented the Illustrated Record of Anomalous Bamboo.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Rong prefecture presented an illustrated record of anomalous bamboo.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，密州獻芝草四本，枝葉扶疏。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, Mi prefecture presented four plants of lingzhi grass, their branches and leaves luxuriant and spreading.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year, Mi prefecture presented four plants of lingzhi grass with luxuriant, spreading branches and leaves.

sentences.zh: 二月，知溫州何士宗獻芝草五本；

translations.literal: In the second month, He Shizong, prefect of Wen prefecture, presented five plants of lingzhi grass;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, He Shizong, prefect of Wen prefecture, presented five plants of lingzhi grass;

sentences.zh: 十月，又獻十本。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, he again presented ten plants.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, he presented ten more plants.

sentences.zh: 至道元年十一月，潭州監軍廨生竹一本，長二尺許，枝葉萬余，尤爲殊異。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Zhidao, one bamboo plant sprouted at the military supervisor's yamen in Tan prefecture; it was about two feet tall, with more than ten thousand branches and leaves—most extraordinarily unusual.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the first year of Zhidao, a single bamboo plant sprouted at the military supervisor's yamen in Tan prefecture; barely two feet tall, it bore more than ten thousand branches and leaves—an especially remarkable prodigy.

sentences.zh: 二年六月，虔州龍泉縣合龍院一竿分兩枝。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year, at Helong Monastery in Longquan county, Gan prefecture, one bamboo culm split into two branches.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year, at Helong Monastery in Longquan county, Gan prefecture, one bamboo culm forked into two branches.

sentences.zh: 河南縣民張知遠家芝草生，判府呂蒙正表上之。

translations.literal: Lingzhi grass sprouted at the home of Zhang Zhiyuan, a commoner of Henan county; Vice-Prefect Lü Mengzheng memorialized the court about it.
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhi grass sprouted at the home of Zhang Zhiyuan, a commoner of Henan county, and Vice-Prefect Lü Mengzheng submitted a memorial reporting it.

sentences.zh: 閏七月，密州獻芝二本。

translations.literal: In the intercalary seventh month, Mi prefecture presented two plants of lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month, Mi prefecture presented two plants of lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，廣東轉運使康戩獻紫芝。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year, Kang Jian, transport commissioner of Guangdong, presented purple lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year, Kang Jian, transport commissioner of Guangdong, presented purple lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 咸平元年十二月，宣化縣保聖山瑞竹生一本二枝。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Xianping, at Baosheng Mountain in Xuanhua county, one plant of auspicious bamboo produced two branches from a single stalk.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Xianping, at Baosheng Mountain in Xuanhua county, one stalk of auspicious bamboo forked into two branches.

sentences.zh: 二年閏二月，宣、池、歙、杭、越、睦、衢、婺諸州箭竹生米如稻。

translations.literal: In the intercalary second month of the second year, arrow bamboo in Xuan, Chi, She, Hang, Yue, Mu, Qu, and Wu prefectures produced grain like rice.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month of the second year, arrow bamboo in Xuan, Chi, She, Hang, Yue, Mu, Qu, and Wu prefectures bore grain like rice.

sentences.zh: 時民饑，采之充食。

translations.literal: The people were then suffering famine and gathered it to eat.
translations.idiomatic: The people were then in famine and gathered it to eat.

sentences.zh: 九月，劍州驛廳梁上生芝草，一枝三朵，其色黃白，知州李仁衡圖以獻。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, lingzhi grass sprouted on a beam in the relay station hall at Jian prefecture; one stalk bore three caps, yellow and white in color; Prefect Li Renheng drew a picture and presented it as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, lingzhi grass sprouted on a beam in the relay station hall at Jian prefecture; one stalk bore three caps, yellow and white in hue, and Prefect Li Renheng drew its likeness and presented it as tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，灘州獻芝草一本，如佛狀。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, Tan prefecture presented one plant of lingzhi grass shaped like a Buddha.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, Tan prefecture presented one plant of lingzhi grass shaped like a Buddha image.

sentences.zh: 十二月，知淮陽軍王礪獻芝草三本。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Wang Li, military commissioner of Huaiyang Army, presented three plants of lingzhi grass.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Wang Li, military commissioner of Huaiyang Army, presented three plants of lingzhi grass.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，導江縣民潘矩田生芝，三層，黃紫色，高五寸許。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year, lingzhi sprouted in Pan Ju's field in Daojiang county; it had three tiers, yellow and purple in color, about five inches tall.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the sixth year, lingzhi sprouted in Pan Ju's field in Daojiang county; it had three tiers, was yellow and purple in color, and stood about five inches tall.

sentences.zh: 九月，相州牧龍坊生芝一莖，色紫黃，長尺餘，分七枝，枝如手五指狀。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, one stalk of lingzhi sprouted at the Muyu Dragon Kennels in Xiang prefecture; purple and yellow in color, more than a foot long, it split into seven branches shaped like the five fingers of a hand.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, one stalk of lingzhi sprouted at the Muyu Dragon Kennels in Xiang prefecture; purple and yellow in color and more than a foot long, it split into seven branches shaped like the five fingers of a hand.

sentences.zh: 其最上枝類鳳者，知州張鑒以獻。

translations.literal: The uppermost branch resembled a phoenix; Prefect Zhang Jian presented it as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Its uppermost branch resembled a phoenix, and Prefect Zhang Jian presented it as tribute.

sentences.zh: 景德三年八月，蔡州獻芝草。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year of Jingde, Cai prefecture presented lingzhi grass as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year of Jingde, Cai prefecture presented lingzhi grass as tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年十月，知廣安軍王奇上《芝草圖》。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year, Wang Qi, military commissioner of Guang'an Army, submitted the Illustrated Record of Lingzhi Grass.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fourth year, Wang Qi, military commissioner of Guang'an Army, submitted an illustrated record of lingzhi grass.

sentences.zh: 十二月，蓬州上《瑞竹圖》。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Peng prefecture submitted the Illustrated Record of Auspicious Bamboo.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Peng prefecture submitted an illustrated record of auspicious bamboo.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符元年四月，溫州獻《瑞竹圖》。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Wen prefecture presented the Illustrated Record of Auspicious Bamboo.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Wen prefecture presented an illustrated record of auspicious bamboo.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未，以東封，遣經度制置使王欽若祭文宣王廟，于孔林得芝五株，色黃紫如雲色，及人戴冠冕之狀。

translations.literal: On xinwei in the fifth month, in preparation for the eastern mount feng rite, the court dispatched Planning and Regulatory Commissioner Wang Qinruo to offer sacrifices at the Temple of the Cultured and Propagated King; at Confucius's grove he obtained five plants of lingzhi, yellow and purple like cloud color, and shaped like a person wearing cap and regalia.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the fifth month, in preparation for the eastern feng rite, the court dispatched Planning and Regulatory Commissioner Wang Qinruo to offer sacrifices at the Temple of the Cultured and Propagated King; in Confucius's grove he found five plants of lingzhi, yellow and purple like clouds and shaped like a person wearing cap and regalia.

sentences.zh: 詔內侍楊懷玉祭謝。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Palace Attendant Yang Huaiyu to offer sacrifices in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Palace Attendant Yang Huaiyu to offer sacrifices in thanksgiving.

sentences.zh: 復得芝四本，輕黃，如雲氣之狀。

translations.literal: Four more plants of lingzhi were obtained, pale yellow, shaped like drifting clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Four more plants of lingzhi were found, pale yellow and shaped like drifting clouds.

sentences.zh: 癸未，內侍江德明于白龍潭石上得紫黃芝一本以獻。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Palace Attendant Jiang Deming obtained one plant of purple-yellow lingzhi on a rock at White Dragon Pool and presented it as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Palace Attendant Jiang Deming found one plant of purple-yellow lingzhi on a rock at White Dragon Pool and presented it as tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月，瑕丘縣民宋固於堯祠前得黃紫芝九本，連理者四；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Song Gu, a commoner of Xiaqiu county, obtained nine plants of yellow-purple lingzhi before the Shrine of Yao; four were conjoined;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Song Gu, a commoner of Xiaqiu county, obtained nine plants of yellow-purple lingzhi before the Shrine of Yao, four of them conjoined;

sentences.zh: 又縣民蔡珍得芝一本，王欽若以獻。

translations.literal: A commoner of the county, Cai Zhen, also obtained one plant of lingzhi, which Wang Qinruo presented as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Another county commoner, Cai Zhen, also obtained one plant of lingzhi, which Wang Qinruo presented as tribute.

sentences.zh: 欽若又于岱嶽及堯祠前，再得芝二十二本。

translations.literal: Qinruo again obtained twenty-two more plants of lingzhi at Mount Dai and before the Shrine of Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Qinruo obtained twenty-two more plants of lingzhi at Mount Dai and again before the Shrine of Yao.

sentences.zh: 連理者二，及有貫草石者。

translations.literal: Two were conjoined, and some pierced through grass and stone.
translations.idiomatic: Two were conjoined, and some pierced through grass and stone.

sentences.zh: 七月，欽若親獲芝十一本，又州長及民所得二十六本，有重台連理及外白內紫之狀，且言：「泰山至日生芝草，軍民競采，請給緡帛。」

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Qinruo personally obtained eleven plants of lingzhi, and the prefect and commoners obtained twenty-six more, including double-tiered and conjoined forms and specimens white outside and purple within; he also reported: "From the summer solstice, lingzhi grass has sprouted on Mount Tai; soldiers and civilians are scrambling to gather it—please grant silk and cash."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Qinruo personally obtained eleven plants of lingzhi, while the prefect and commoners obtained twenty-six more, including double-tiered and conjoined forms and specimens white outside and purple within; he also reported: "Since the summer solstice, lingzhi grass has sprouted on Mount Tai, and soldiers and civilians are scrambling to gather it—please grant silk and cash."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 兗州獄空，司理參軍郭保讓掃除其間，得芝四本。

translations.literal: The prison at Yan prefecture stood empty; Judicial Assistant Guo Baorang, sweeping it out, found four plants of lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: The prison at Yan prefecture stood empty, and when Judicial Assistant Guo Baorang swept it out, he found four plants of lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 八月，須城縣民家芝草生。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, lingzhi grass sprouted at a commoner's home in Xucheng county.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, lingzhi grass sprouted at a commoner's home in Xucheng county.

sentences.zh: 乾封縣民家屋柱生芝。

translations.literal: Lingzhi sprouted on a roof pillar at a commoner's home in Qianfeng county.
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhi sprouted on a roof pillar at a commoner's home in Qianfeng county.

sentences.zh: 滋長連袤，色鮮潔如繪畫。

translations.literal: It spread and grew continuously, its colors fresh and bright as though painted.
translations.idiomatic: It spread and grew without break, its colors fresh and bright as though painted.

sentences.zh: 欽若獻芝草八千一百三十九本，有貫草木、附石、連理及飾爲寶山者。

translations.literal: Qinruo presented eight thousand one hundred thirty-nine plants of lingzhi grass, including some that pierced through grass and trees, clung to rocks, grew conjoined, or were arrayed to form jeweled mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Qinruo presented eight thousand one hundred thirty-nine plants of lingzhi grass, including specimens that pierced through grass and trees, clung to rocks, grew conjoined, or were arranged to form jeweled mountains.

sentences.zh: 黃州獻異竹一本雙莖。

translations.literal: Huang prefecture presented anomalous bamboo, one plant with twin stalks.
translations.idiomatic: Huang prefecture presented anomalous bamboo, one plant with twin stalks.

sentences.zh: 九月，趙安仁來獻五色金玉丹紫芝八千七百十一本。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Zhao Anren came to present eight thousand seven hundred eleven plants of multicolored jade-gold cinnabar-purple lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Zhao Anren came to present eight thousand seven hundred eleven plants of multicolored jade-gold cinnabar-purple lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 鞏縣柴務牡丹華。

translations.literal: At the firewood office in Gong county, peonies bloomed.
translations.idiomatic: At the firewood office in Gong county, peonies bloomed.

sentences.zh: 十月，泰山芝草再生者甚衆。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, lingzhi grass regenerated on Mount Tai in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, lingzhi grass regenerated on Mount Tai in great numbers.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，車駕次鄆州，知州馬元方獻芝草五本。

translations.literal: On xinchou, when the imperial carriage stopped at Yan prefecture, Ma Yuanfang, prefect of the prefecture, presented five plants of lingzhi grass.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, when the imperial carriage halted at Yan prefecture, Prefect Ma Yuanfang presented five plants of lingzhi grass.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，欽若等又獻泰山芝草三萬八千五十本，有並五連、三連理者，五色重暈如寶蓋，下相連帶，凡草木五穀如寶山、靈禽、瑞獸之象者六百四十二。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Qinruo and others again presented thirty-eight thousand fifty plants of lingzhi grass from Mount Tai, including specimens joined in fives, conjoined in threes, with five-colored layered halos like jeweled canopies and linked stems below—altogether six hundred forty-two shaped like jeweled mountains, auspicious birds, or miraculous beasts among grasses, trees, and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Qinruo and others again presented thirty-eight thousand fifty plants of lingzhi grass from Mount Tai, including specimens joined in fives and conjoined in threes, with five-colored layered halos like jeweled canopies and linked stems below—altogether six hundred forty-two shaped like jeweled mountains, auspicious birds, or miraculous beasts among grasses, trees, and grain.

sentences.zh: 詔令封禪日列天書輦前，又送諸路名山勝景及賜宰相。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that on the day of the feng and shan rites they be arranged before the imperial carriage bearing the Celestial Writings, and also sent to famous mountains and scenic sites along the routes and granted to the chancellors.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that on the day of the feng and shan rites they be arrayed before the imperial carriage bearing the Celestial Writings, and also sent to famous mountains and scenic sites along the routes and granted to the chancellors.

sentences.zh: 是月，復州獻芝草，類神仙佛像。

translations.literal: That same month, Fu prefecture presented lingzhi grass shaped like immortals and Buddha images.
translations.idiomatic: That same month, Fu prefecture presented lingzhi grass shaped like immortals and Buddha images.

sentences.zh: 河中府酒廚梁上生芝，一本十二葉，其色如玉。

translations.literal: Lingzhi sprouted on a beam in the wine brewery at Hezhong prefecture; one plant had twelve leaves, jade-like in color.
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhi sprouted on a beam in the wine brewery at Hezhong prefecture; one plant had twelve leaves, jade-like in color.

sentences.zh: 安陽縣段贊家紫芝連理，長尺餘，又民李釗屋柱生芝三本。

translations.literal: At Duan Zan's home in Anyang county, conjoined purple lingzhi more than a foot long; also at commoner Li Zhao's home, three plants sprouted on a roof pillar.
translations.idiomatic: At Duan Zan's home in Anyang county, conjoined purple lingzhi more than a foot long sprouted, and at commoner Li Zhao's home three plants sprouted on a roof pillar.

sentences.zh: 霍丘縣河亭及聖惠坊並有紫芝生。

translations.literal: In Huoqiu county, purple lingzhi sprouted both at the River Pavilion and at Shenghui ward.
translations.idiomatic: In Huoqiu county, purple lingzhi sprouted both at the River Pavilion and at Shenghui ward.

sentences.zh: 十二月，福州懷安縣龍眼樹上紫芝連理。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, conjoined purple lingzhi sprouted on a longan tree in Huai'an county, Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, conjoined purple lingzhi sprouted on a longan tree in Huai'an county, Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 溫州獻《靈芝圖》。

translations.literal: Wen prefecture presented the Illustrated Record of Spirit Lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Wen prefecture presented an illustrated record of spirit lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，福州荔枝樹生連理芝二本。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, two plants of conjoined lingzhi sprouted on a lychee tree in Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year, two plants of conjoined lingzhi sprouted on a lychee tree in Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月，饒州獻芝草四本。

translations.literal: In the second month, Raozhou presented four plants of lingzhi grass.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Raozhou presented four plants of lingzhi grass.

sentences.zh: 七月，遂州皇澤寺芝草生，凡五十本。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, lingzhi grass sprouted at Huangze Temple in Suizhou—fifty plants in all.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, lingzhi grass sprouted at Huangze Temple in Suizhou—fifty plants in all.

sentences.zh: 九月，榮州廨庭中生芝二本。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, two plants of lingzhi sprouted in the courtyard of the yamen at Rong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, two plants of lingzhi sprouted in the courtyard of the yamen at Rong prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十月，果州青居山獻金暈連理芝草。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Qingju Mountain in Guo prefecture presented golden-halo conjoined lingzhi grass.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Qingju Mountain in Guo prefecture presented golden-halo conjoined lingzhi grass.

sentences.zh: 十一月，華山張超谷石上生紫芝二本。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, two plants of purple lingzhi sprouted on a rock in Zhangchao Valley on Mount Hua.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, two plants of purple lingzhi sprouted on a rock in Zhangchao Valley on Mount Hua.

sentences.zh: 嵩嶽生芝草五十本。

translations.literal: Fifty plants of lingzhi grass sprouted on Mount Song.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty plants of lingzhi grass sprouted on Mount Song.

sentences.zh: 石首縣文宣王廟殿柱芝草生。

translations.literal: Lingzhi grass sprouted on a hall pillar at the Temple of the Cultured and Propagated King in Shishou county.
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhi grass sprouted on a hall pillar at the Temple of the Cultured and Propagated King in Shishou county.

sentences.zh: 又龍蓋山萬福裏民宗永昌園藤上芝草生，一本雙莖。

translations.literal: Also, at the garden of Zong Yongchang, a resident of Wanfu Lane on Longgai Mountain, lingzhi grass sprouted on a vine—one plant, twin stalks.
translations.idiomatic: Also, at the garden of Zong Yongchang, a resident of Wanfu Lane on Longgai Mountain, lingzhi grass sprouted on a vine, one plant with twin stalks.

sentences.zh: 十二月，漢州芝草生。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, lingzhi grass sprouted in Han prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, lingzhi grass sprouted in Han prefecture.

sentences.zh: 黔州芝草一莖十二枝，若山峰狀。

translations.literal: In Qian prefecture, one stalk of lingzhi grass bore twelve branches shaped like mountain peaks.
translations.idiomatic: In Qian prefecture, one stalk of lingzhi grass bore twelve branches shaped like mountain peaks.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，井研縣三惠寺生芝草十本。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, ten plants of lingzhi grass sprouted at Sanhui Temple in Jingyan county.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year, ten plants of lingzhi grass sprouted at Sanhui Temple in Jingyan county.

sentences.zh: 二月，昌州廨廳柱芝生四本。

translations.literal: In the second month, four plants of lingzhi sprouted on a hall pillar at the yamen of Chang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, four plants of lingzhi sprouted on a hall pillar at the yamen of Chang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 閏二月，饒州芝草生。

translations.literal: In the intercalary second month, lingzhi grass sprouted in Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month, lingzhi grass sprouted in Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 三月，西充縣青蓮塔院、太平觀並生芝草。

translations.literal: In the third month, lingzhi grass sprouted both at Qinglian Pagoda Monastery and at Taiping Abbey in Xichong county.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, lingzhi grass sprouted both at Qinglian Pagoda Monastery and at Taiping Abbey in Xichong county.

sentences.zh: 四月，京師竹有華，占云：「歲不豐。」

translations.literal: In the fourth month, bamboo in the capital bloomed; divination said: "The harvest will not be plentiful."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, bamboo in the capital bloomed, and divination read the sign as: "The harvest will not be plentiful."

sentences.zh: 六月，綿、邵、鄂州並芝草生。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, lingzhi grass sprouted in Mian, Shao, and E prefectures alike.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, lingzhi grass sprouted in Mian, Shao, and E prefectures alike.

sentences.zh: 七月，虢州聖女觀生芝草三本。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, three plants of lingzhi grass sprouted at the Abbey of the Holy Maiden in Guo prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, three plants of lingzhi grass sprouted at the Abbey of the Holy Maiden in Guo prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八月，潁縣民得田芝十二本。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, a commoner of Ying county obtained twelve field-grown plants of lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, a commoner of Ying county obtained twelve field-grown plants of lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 蜀州生芝草，一莖九葉。

translations.literal: Lingzhi grass sprouted in Shu prefecture; one stalk had nine leaves.
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhi grass sprouted in Shu prefecture; one stalk bore nine leaves.

sentences.zh: 江陵縣民張仲家竹自根上分幹，其一干又分三莖，九月，江陵府永泰寺竹出地七節，分爲兩莖，長丈余，知府陳堯咨以聞。

translations.literal: At the home of Zhang Zhong, a commoner of Jiangling county, bamboo split into trunks from the root, one trunk further dividing into three stalks; in the ninth month, at Yongtai Temple in Jiangling prefecture, bamboo emerged from the ground in seven nodes, splitting into two stalks more than a ten-foot length long—Prefect Chen Yaozi reported it.
translations.idiomatic: At the home of Zhang Zhong, a commoner of Jiangling county, bamboo split into trunks from the root, one trunk further dividing into three stalks; in the ninth month, at Yongtai Temple in Jiangling prefecture, bamboo emerged from the ground in seven nodes and split into two stalks more than ten feet long, and Prefect Chen Yaozi reported it to the court.

sentences.zh: 華州敷水民侯元則入華陽川石罅，得芝一本，知州顧端以獻。

translations.literal: Hou Yuanze, a commoner of Fushui in Hua prefecture, entered a crevice in Huayang Valley and obtained one plant of lingzhi; Prefect Gu Duan presented it as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Yuanze, a commoner of Fushui in Hua prefecture, entered a crevice in Huayang Valley and obtained one plant of lingzhi, which Prefect Gu Duan presented as tribute.

sentences.zh: 十月，內侍任文慶詣茅山，設醮洞中，獲芝草二十八本， 有如人手者。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Palace Attendant Ren Wenqing went to Mount Mao, set up an altar offering in a cave, and obtained twenty-eight plants of lingzhi grass, some shaped like human hands.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Palace Attendant Ren Wenqing went to Mount Mao, set up an altar offering in a cave, and obtained twenty-eight plants of lingzhi grass, some shaped like human hands.

sentences.zh: 十一月，安鄉縣謝山獲芝二十二本，其七狀如珊瑚而色紫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, twenty-two plants of lingzhi were obtained at Xie Mountain in Anxiang county; seven were shaped like coral and purple in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, twenty-two plants of lingzhi were obtained at Xie Mountain in Anxiang county, seven of them shaped like coral and purple in color.

sentences.zh: 十二月，神泉縣獲芝四本。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, four plants of lingzhi were obtained in Shenquan county.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, four plants of lingzhi were obtained in Shenquan county.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，知華州崔端獻芝草，狀如仙人掌。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, Cui Duan, prefect of Hua prefecture, presented lingzhi grass shaped like a cactus.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, Cui Duan, prefect of Hua prefecture, presented lingzhi grass shaped like a cactus.

sentences.zh: 須城縣民李道安于黃仙公洞臺上得芝草一本以獻。

translations.literal: Li Dao'an, a commoner of Xucheng county, obtained one plant of lingzhi grass on the terrace of Yellow Immortal Lord's Cave and presented it as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Li Dao'an, a commoner of Xucheng county, obtained one plant of lingzhi grass on the terrace of Yellow Immortal Lord's Cave and presented it as tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月，崔端又獻芝草十本。

translations.literal: In the second month, Cui Duan again presented ten plants of lingzhi grass.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Cui Duan again presented ten plants of lingzhi grass.

sentences.zh: 知益州任中正獻芝草二十二本。

translations.literal: Ren Zhongzheng, prefect of Yi prefecture, presented twenty-two plants of lingzhi grass.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Zhongzheng, prefect of Yi prefecture, presented twenty-two plants of lingzhi grass.

sentences.zh: 知遂州毋賓古獻芝草。

translations.literal: Wu Binggu, prefect of Suizhou, presented lingzhi grass.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Binggu, prefect of Suizhou, presented lingzhi grass.

sentences.zh: 四月，古田縣僧舍竹一本，上分三莖。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, at a monk's dwelling in Gutian county, one bamboo plant split into three stalks at the top.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, at a monk's dwelling in Gutian county, one bamboo plant split into three stalks at the top.

sentences.zh: 端昌縣民李讓家筀竹一本，去地五尺許，分爲二莖，知州范應辰以聞。

translations.literal: At the home of Li Rang, a commoner of Duanchang county, one stalk of thin bamboo about five feet above the ground split into two stalks; Prefect Fan Yingchen reported it.
translations.idiomatic: At the home of Li Rang, a commoner of Duanchang county, one stalk of thin bamboo about five feet above the ground split into two stalks, and Prefect Fan Yingchen reported it to the court.

sentences.zh: 六月，夔州芝草生稟舍中。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, lingzhi grass grew in the granary office at Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, lingzhi grass sprouted in the granary office at Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 七月，知亳州徐泌、知江州王文震並獻芝草。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Xu Bi, prefect of Bozhou, and Wang Wenzhen, prefect of Jiangzhou, both presented lingzhi grass.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Xu Bi, prefect of Bozhou, and Wang Wenzhen, prefect of Jiangzhou, both presented lingzhi grass to the court.

sentences.zh: 知郴州袁延慶獻芝草十本。

translations.literal: Yuan Yanqing, prefect of Chenzhou, presented ten plants of lingzhi grass.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Yanqing, prefect of Chenzhou, presented ten plants of lingzhi grass.

sentences.zh: 八月，邕州雲封寺柏樹生芝五本，知州劉知詰以獻。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, five plants of lingzhi grew on a cypress tree at Yunfeng Temple in Yongzhou; Prefect Liu Zhijie presented them as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, five plants of lingzhi grew on a cypress at Yunfeng Temple in Yongzhou, and Prefect Liu Zhijie presented them to the court.

sentences.zh: 西充縣廣川王廟生芝十本，其三連理。

translations.literal: At the Temple of the Prince of Guangchuan in Xichong county, ten plants of lingzhi grew; three of them were conjoined.
translations.idiomatic: At the Temple of the Prince of Guangchuan in Xichong county, ten plants of lingzhi appeared, three of them conjoined in pairs.

sentences.zh: 八月，知信州李放獻《瑞竹圖》三本。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Li Fang, prefect of Xinzhou, presented three copies of the Illustrated Record of Auspicious Bamboo.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Li Fang, prefect of Xinzhou, presented three illustrated records of auspicious bamboo.

sentences.zh: 十一月，河中府獻芝草。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Hezhong prefecture presented lingzhi grass.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Hezhong prefecture presented lingzhi grass.

sentences.zh: 眞源縣民王順慈、司徒捷家生芝各一本。

translations.literal: At the homes of Wang Shunci and Situ Jie, commoners of Zhenyuan county, one plant of lingzhi grew at each.
translations.idiomatic: One plant of lingzhi grew at the home of each of two commoners in Zhenyuan county, Wang Shunci and Situ Jie.

sentences.zh: 岳州、道州並獻芝草。

translations.literal: Yuezhou and Daozhou both presented lingzhi grass.
translations.idiomatic: Yuezhou and Daozhou both presented lingzhi grass.

sentences.zh: 南嶽奉冊使薛映、副使錢惟演過荊門軍神林石上，獲芝草以獻。

translations.literal: Xue Ying, commissioner bearing the southern marchmount investiture, and Vice Commissioner Qian Weiyan, passing the sacred grove stone at Jingmen Army, obtained lingzhi grass and presented it as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Xue Ying, bearing the southern marchmount investiture, and Vice Commissioner Qian Weiyan obtained lingzhi grass on the sacred grove stone at Jingmen Army and presented it to the court.

sentences.zh: 十二月，鉛山縣仁壽僧舍生芝草一本，雙枝，長尺八寸。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, one plant of lingzhi grass with twin branches, one foot eight inches long, grew at the Renshou monk's dwelling in Qianshan county.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, a twin-branched plant of lingzhi grass one foot eight inches long grew at the Renshou monk's dwelling in Qianshan county.

sentences.zh: 五年六月，潯州六祖院法堂紫芝雙秀，知州高志甯以聞。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year, twin purple lingzhi plants sprouted in the dharma hall of the Sixth Patriarch's Monastery in Xunzhou; Prefect Gao Zhining reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year, twin purple lingzhi plants sprouted in the dharma hall of the Sixth Patriarch's Monastery in Xunzhou, and Prefect Gao Zhining reported it to the court.

sentences.zh: 八月，亳州獻芝草。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Bozhou presented lingzhi grass.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Bozhou presented lingzhi grass.

sentences.zh: 十月，澤州廳事梁上，生白莖紫蓋芝二十四本。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, twenty-four plants of lingzhi with white stems and purple caps grew on a beam in the main hall of Ze prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, twenty-four plants of lingzhi with white stems and purple caps grew on a beam in the main hall at Ze prefecture.

sentences.zh: 閏十月，常州芝草生。

translations.literal: In the intercalary tenth month, lingzhi grass grew in Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary tenth month, lingzhi grass appeared in Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 又蕭山縣芝生李樹上十一本。

translations.literal: Also in Xiaoshan county, eleven plants of lingzhi grew on a plum tree.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiaoshan county as well, eleven plants of lingzhi grew on a plum tree.

sentences.zh: 十一月，廣州獻芝草二百三十七本。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Guangzhou presented two hundred thirty-seven plants of lingzhi grass.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Guangzhou presented two hundred thirty-seven plants of lingzhi grass.

sentences.zh: 晉原縣僧舍芝草一本。

translations.literal: One plant of lingzhi grass at a monk's dwelling in Jinyuan county.
translations.idiomatic: One plant of lingzhi grass grew at a monk's dwelling in Jinyuan county.

sentences.zh: 十二月，隨州芝草生。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, lingzhi grass grew in Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, lingzhi grass appeared in Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 亳州獻鹿邑縣民所獲芝草四本。

translations.literal: Bozhou presented four plants of lingzhi grass obtained by commoners of Luyi county.
translations.idiomatic: Bozhou presented four plants of lingzhi grass that commoners of Luyi county had obtained.

sentences.zh: 候官縣山上生芝草五十四本。

translations.literal: On a mountain in Houguan county, fifty-four plants of lingzhi grass grew.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty-four plants of lingzhi grass grew on a mountain in Houguan county.

sentences.zh: 閩縣望泉寺生芝草十本。

translations.literal: At Wangquan Temple in Min county, ten plants of lingzhi grass grew.
translations.idiomatic: Ten plants of lingzhi grass grew at Wangquan Temple in Min county.

sentences.zh: 甯德縣支提山石上生芝草十五本。

translations.literal: On the rocks of Zhití Mountain in Ningde county, fifteen plants of lingzhi grass grew.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen plants of lingzhi grass grew on the rocks of Zhití Mountain in Ningde county.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，江州廬山崇聖院生芝九本，知州王文震以獻。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year, nine plants of lingzhi grew at Chongsheng Monastery on Mount Lu in Jiangzhou; Prefect Wang Wenzhen presented them as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the sixth year, nine plants of lingzhi grew at Chongsheng Monastery on Mount Lu in Jiangzhou, and Prefect Wang Wenzhen presented them to the court.

sentences.zh: 四月，饒州承天院東山生芝四本，連葉。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, four plants of lingzhi with conjoined leaves grew on East Mountain at Chengtian Monastery in Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, four plants of lingzhi with conjoined leaves grew on East Mountain at Chengtian Monastery in Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 六月，壽丘縣獲紫莖金芝一本。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, one plant of purple-stemmed golden lingzhi was obtained in Shouqiu county.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, one plant of purple-stemmed golden lingzhi was found in Shouqiu county.

sentences.zh: 景陵縣管陽山林中獲芝三十本。

translations.literal: In the Guanyang Mountain forest of Jingling county, thirty plants of lingzhi were obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty plants of lingzhi were found in the Guanyang Mountain forest of Jingling county.

sentences.zh: 七月，內侍石延福登兗州壽丘，獲芝一本，貫草而生，又旁得三十本。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Palace Attendant Shi Yanfu climbed Shouqiu in Yanzhou and obtained one plant of lingzhi growing through the grass; he also obtained thirty more nearby.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Palace Attendant Shi Yanfu climbed Shouqiu in Yanzhou and found one plant of lingzhi growing up through the grass, then thirty more nearby.

sentences.zh: 亳州團練使高漢英獻芝八本。

translations.literal: Gao Hanying, regimental commander of Bozhou, presented eight plants of lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Hanying, regimental commander of Bozhou, presented eight plants of lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 鼎州城門柱下生芝一本。

translations.literal: One plant of lingzhi grew beneath a gate pillar in Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: One plant of lingzhi grew beneath a gate pillar in Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月，繼照堂生芝一本，紫莖黃蓋。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, one plant of lingzhi with purple stem and yellow cap grew in the Hall of Continued Illumination.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, one plant of lingzhi with a purple stem and yellow cap grew in the Hall of Continued Illumination.

sentences.zh: 奉祀經度制置使丁謂至眞源縣，太清宮道士、瀨陽鄉民繼獲芝八十本以獻。

translations.literal: Ding Wei, Commissioner for Sacrificial Rites and Planning and Regulatory Affairs, arrived at Zhenyuan county; Taoist priests of the Grand Purity Palace and commoners of Laiyang township successively obtained eighty plants of lingzhi and presented them as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: When Ding Wei, Commissioner for Sacrificial Rites and Planning and Regulatory Affairs, arrived at Zhenyuan county, Taoist priests of the Grand Purity Palace and commoners of Laiyang township successively found eighty plants of lingzhi and presented them to the court.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，又獲二百五十本，有一本三莖，一莖如雲氣佛像者。

translations.literal: On yichou, two hundred fifty more were obtained; one plant had three stalks, and one stalk was shaped like a Buddha image in cloud vapor.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, two hundred fifty more were found; one plant had three stalks, one of them shaped like a Buddha image formed from cloud vapor.

sentences.zh: 九月，又得宋城縣民所獲芝五十本獻之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, fifty more plants of lingzhi obtained by commoners of Songcheng county were again presented as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, fifty more plants of lingzhi that commoners of Songcheng county had obtained were presented to the court.

sentences.zh: 十月，丁謂來朝，獻芝草三萬七千一百八本，飾以仙人、寶禽、異獸之狀；

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Ding Wei came to court and presented thirty-seven thousand one hundred eight plants of lingzhi grass, adorned with shapes of immortals, precious birds, and exotic beasts;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Ding Wei came to court and presented thirty-seven thousand one hundred eight plants of lingzhi grass, fashioned into the shapes of immortals, precious birds, and exotic beasts;

sentences.zh: 十一月，又獻九萬五千一百本。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, he again presented ninety-five thousand one hundred plants.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, he presented ninety-five thousand one hundred more.

sentences.zh: 明年，車駕至眞源，民有詣行闕獻者，又一萬八千本。

translations.literal: The next year, when the imperial carriage reached Zhenyuan, commoners who came to the travel lodge to present tribute offered another eighteen thousand plants.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, when the imperial carriage reached Zhenyuan, commoners who came to the travel lodge to present tribute offered another eighteen thousand plants.

sentences.zh: 是冬，兗州景靈宮芝草生。

translations.literal: That winter, lingzhi grass grew at Jingling Palace in Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, lingzhi grass appeared at Jingling Palace in Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 慶成軍大寧廟聖制碑閣生金芝二本。

translations.literal: At the imperial-inscription stele pavilion of Daning Temple in Qingcheng Army, two plants of golden lingzhi grew.
translations.idiomatic: Two plants of golden lingzhi grew at the imperial-inscription stele pavilion of Daning Temple in Qingcheng Army.

sentences.zh: 昭州龍岳山資壽寺芝草生。

translations.literal: Lingzhi grass grew at Zishou Temple on Longyue Mountain in Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhi grass appeared at Zishou Temple on Longyue Mountain in Shaozhou.

sentences.zh: 潯州廳廨柱芝生一本，上分爲二，其上又生二本，凡三重。

translations.literal: One plant of lingzhi grew on a pillar of the prefectural office in Xunzhou; at the top it split into two, and above that two more grew, three tiers in all.
translations.idiomatic: One plant of lingzhi grew on a pillar of the prefectural office in Xunzhou, splitting into two at the top and then sprouting two more above that, three tiers in all.

sentences.zh: 無錫縣民曹詵家食案生芝，赤黃有光，長尺許。

translations.literal: At the home of Cao Shen, a commoner of Wuxi county, lingzhi grew on a dining table, red-yellow and luminous, about a foot long.
translations.idiomatic: At the home of Cao Shen, a commoner of Wuxi county, lingzhi grew on a dining table, red-yellow and glowing, about a foot long.

sentences.zh: 又知南安軍章得一獻芝草。

translations.literal: Also, Zhang Deyi, military commissioner of Nan'an Army, presented lingzhi grass.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Deyi, military commissioner of Nan'an Army, also presented lingzhi grass.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，明州獻茹侯山石上芝草一本四莖。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year, Mingzhou presented one plant of lingzhi grass with four stalks on a rock at Ruhou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year, Mingzhou presented one four-stalked plant of lingzhi grass growing on a rock at Ruhou Mountain.

sentences.zh: 二月，知信州歐陽陟獻芝草七本，忠州獻芝五本。

translations.literal: In the second month, Ouyang Zhi, prefect of Xinzhou, presented seven plants of lingzhi grass, and Zhongzhou presented five plants of lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Ouyang Zhi, prefect of Xinzhou, presented seven plants of lingzhi grass, and Zhongzhou presented five.

sentences.zh: 四月，福州獻芝草二本。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Fuzhou presented two plants of lingzhi grass.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Fuzhou presented two plants of lingzhi grass.

sentences.zh: 五月，郪縣西上石崖生紫芝十五本。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, fifteen plants of purple lingzhi grew on a cliff west of Qixian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, fifteen plants of purple lingzhi grew on a cliff west of Qixian.

sentences.zh: 七月，華州民入華山，得白 石上芝草，雙莖連蓋。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, a commoner of Hua prefecture entered Mount Hua and obtained lingzhi grass on white stone, with twin stalks and conjoined caps.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, a commoner of Hua prefecture entered Mount Hua and found lingzhi grass on white stone, with twin stalks and conjoined caps.

sentences.zh: 八月，均州、獻州獻芝千二百二十七本。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Junzhou and Xianzhou presented one thousand two hundred twenty-seven plants of lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Junzhou and Xianzhou together presented one thousand two hundred twenty-seven plants of lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 十月，慶成軍大寧廟石雙莖芝生，其上合幹，明、英二州芝草生。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, twin-stalked lingzhi grew on a stone at Daning Temple in Qingcheng Army, their trunks merging above; lingzhi grass also grew in Ming and Ying prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, twin-stalked lingzhi grew on a stone at Daning Temple in Qingcheng Army with merged trunks above, and lingzhi grass appeared in Ming and Ying prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十一月，蜀州芝草二本生竹根。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, two plants of lingzhi grass grew from bamboo roots in Shuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, two plants of lingzhi grass grew from bamboo roots in Shuzhou.

sentences.zh: 八年二月，青州武成王廟柱生芝一本，知州張知白以圖獻。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighth year, one plant of lingzhi grew on a pillar of the Temple of the Martial Completion King in Qingzhou; Prefect Zhang Zhibai presented an illustration as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighth year, one plant of lingzhi grew on a pillar of the Temple of the Martial Completion King in Qingzhou, and Prefect Zhang Zhibai presented an illustration to the court.

sentences.zh: 三月，榮州應靈縣彌陀佛舍生紫芝三本，其一雙幹，上如蓋。

translations.literal: In the third month, three plants of purple lingzhi grew at a Amitabha monk's dwelling in Yingling county, Rongzhou; one had twin trunks with cap-like tops.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, three plants of purple lingzhi grew at an Amitabha monk's dwelling in Yingling county, Rongzhou; one had twin trunks topped like caps.

sentences.zh: 四月，昌州有芝生石上，一本四莖，其色黃白。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, in Changzhou lingzhi grew on stone; one plant had four stalks, yellow-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month in Changzhou, lingzhi grew on stone; one plant had four yellow-white stalks.

sentences.zh: 四月，彰明縣民家竹一根，上分二本、十三節。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, at a commoner's home in Zhangming county, one bamboo stalk forked into two branches at the top with thirteen nodes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, at a commoner's home in Zhangming county, one bamboo stalk forked into two branches at the top across thirteen nodes.

sentences.zh: 又開元寺桃竹一莖，上分十八節，皆相對。

translations.literal: Also at Kaiyuan Temple, one stalk of peach bamboo forked at the top into eighteen nodes, all paired opposite one another.
translations.idiomatic: At Kaiyuan Temple as well, one stalk of peach bamboo forked at the top into eighteen nodes, all paired opposite one another.

sentences.zh: 五月，道州舜祠旁生芝二十一本。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, twenty-one plants of lingzhi grew beside the Shrine of Shun in Daozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, twenty-one plants of lingzhi grew beside the Shrine of Shun in Daozhou.

sentences.zh: 六月，盩啡縣民家芝草三莖，共成一葉，又石芝一本。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, at a commoner's home in Zhifei county, lingzhi grass had three stalks sharing one leaf, and one plant of stone lingzhi also appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, at a commoner's home in Zhifei county, lingzhi grass had three stalks sharing one leaf, and one plant of stone lingzhi appeared as well.

sentences.zh: 十月，晉原縣民柏扆家生芝三根，合爲一本。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, at the home of Bai Yi, a commoner of Jinyuan county, three stalks of lingzhi grew and merged into one plant.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, at the home of Bai Yi, a commoner of Jinyuan county, three stalks of lingzhi grew and merged into one plant.

sentences.zh: 九年七月，知信州董溫獻芝十二本。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the ninth year, Dong Wen, prefect of Xinzhou, presented twelve plants of lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the ninth year, Dong Wen, prefect of Xinzhou, presented twelve plants of lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 八月，知廬州餘獻卿獻芝二本。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Yu Xianqing, prefect of Luzhou, presented two plants of lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Yu Xianqing, prefect of Luzhou, presented two plants of lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 九月，涪城縣石壁生芝一本。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, one plant of lingzhi grew on a stone cliff in Fucheng county.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, one plant of lingzhi grew on a stone cliff in Fucheng county.

sentences.zh: 十一月，武岡縣民何文化園竹生兩株同本，上分四莖。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, in the bamboo garden of He Wenhua, a commoner of Wugang county, two plants grew from one root and forked into four stalks at the top.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, in the bamboo garden of He Wenhua, a commoner of Wugang county, two plants grew from one root and forked into four stalks at the top.

sentences.zh: 十二月，晉原縣民李彥滔家竹一本，雙莖對節，知州王世昌圖以獻。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, at the home of Li Yantao, a commoner of Jinyuan county, one bamboo plant had twin stalks with paired nodes; Prefect Wang Shichang presented an illustration as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, at the home of Li Yantao, a commoner of Jinyuan county, one bamboo plant had twin stalks with paired nodes, and Prefect Wang Shichang presented an illustration to the court.

sentences.zh: 天禧元年三月，新津縣平蓋下玉皇案下芝草生。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Tianxi, lingzhi grass grew beneath the Pinggai canopy and beneath the Jade Emperor altar in Xinjin county.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Tianxi, lingzhi grass grew beneath the Pinggai canopy and the Jade Emperor altar in Xinjin county.

sentences.zh: 鄂州天慶觀聖祖殿芝草生。

translations.literal: Lingzhi grass grew in the Hall of the Sacred Ancestor at Tianqing Abbey in Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhi grass appeared in the Hall of the Sacred Ancestor at Tianqing Abbey in Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 四月，邵陽等縣竹生穗如米，民饑，食之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, in Shaoyang and other counties bamboo produced grain-like spikes; the people were hungry and ate them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, in Shaoyang and other counties bamboo produced grain-like spikes; the people, suffering famine, ate them.

sentences.zh: 又浮梁縣竹生穗如米。

translations.literal: Also in Fuliang county, bamboo produced grain-like spikes.
translations.idiomatic: In Fuliang county as well, bamboo produced grain-like spikes.

sentences.zh: 七月，漢陽軍太平興國寺異竹一本，生二莖，節皆相對。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, at Taiping Xingguo Temple in Hanyang Army, one extraordinary bamboo plant produced two stalks, all nodes paired opposite one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, at Taiping Xingguo Temple in Hanyang Army, one extraordinary bamboo plant produced two stalks with all nodes paired opposite one another.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午。

translations.literal: On gengwu in the twelfth month.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the twelfth month.

sentences.zh: 內出芝草如眞武像。

translations.literal: From within the palace, lingzhi grass resembling the image of the True Warrior was presented.
translations.idiomatic: From within the palace, lingzhi grass shaped like the image of the True Warrior was presented.

sentences.zh: 二年正月庚子，內出眞遊、崇徽二殿《梁上芝草圖》示宰相。

translations.literal: On gengzi in the first month of the second year, from within the palace the Illustrated Record of Lingzhi Grass on Beams from the Halls of True Wandering and Honored Insignia was shown to the chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the first month of the second year, the palace showed the chief ministers illustrated records of lingzhi grass on beams from the Halls of True Wandering and Honored Insignia.

sentences.zh: 五月，兗州景靈宮昭慶殿生金芝二本。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, two plants of golden lingzhi grew in the Zhaqing Hall of Jingling Palace in Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, two plants of golden lingzhi grew in the Zhaqing Hall of Jingling Palace in Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年六月，漢陽軍芝草生一百五十餘本。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year, more than one hundred fifty plants of lingzhi grass grew in Hanyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year, more than one hundred fifty plants of lingzhi grass appeared in Hanyang Army.

sentences.zh: 七月，嵩山崇福宮獲芝草一百本，有重台連理、貫草者，知河南府馮拯以獻。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, one hundred plants of lingzhi grass were obtained at Chongfu Palace on Mount Song; some were double-decked and conjoined, and some grew through the grass; Feng Zheng, prefect of Henan prefecture, presented them as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, one hundred plants of lingzhi grass were found at Chongfu Palace on Mount Song, some double-decked and conjoined and some growing up through the grass, and Feng Zheng, prefect of Henan prefecture, presented them to the court.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，梁山軍民王崇扆竹園生金暈紫芝五本。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year, five plants of purple lingzhi with golden halos grew in the bamboo garden of Wang Chongyi, a commoner of Liangshan Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year, five plants of purple lingzhi ringed with golden halos grew in the bamboo garden of Wang Chongyi, a commoner of Liangshan Army.

sentences.zh: 十一月，上饒縣民王壽園中生芝草三本，皆金暈，其二連理。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, three plants of lingzhi grass grew in the garden of Wang Shou, a commoner of Shangrao county; all had golden halos, and two were conjoined.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, three plants of lingzhi grass grew in the garden of Wang Shou, a commoner of Shangrao county; all bore golden halos, and two were conjoined.

sentences.zh: 乾興元年六月，蘇、秀二州湖田生聖米，居民取以食。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Qianxing, sacred grain grew in the lake fields of Su and Xiu prefectures, and the residents gathered it for food.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Qianxing, sacred grain appeared in the lake fields of Su and Xiu prefectures, and the residents gathered it to eat.

sentences.zh: 興州竹有實，如大麥，民取以食。

translations.literal: In Xingzhou bamboo bore seed like barley, and the people gathered it for food.
translations.idiomatic: In Xingzhou bamboo bore seed the size of barley, and the people gathered it to eat.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大饑。」

translations.literal: The omen interpretation says: "Great famine."
translations.idiomatic: The omen interpretation says: "Great famine."

sentences.zh: 八月，洋州民李永負土成母墳，芝生墳上。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Li Yong, a commoner of Yang prefecture, carried earth to complete his mother's grave mound, and lingzhi grew on the mound.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Li Yong, a commoner of Yang prefecture, carried earth to complete his mother's grave mound, and lingzhi grew upon it.

sentences.zh: 天聖元年五月，興州竹有實如大麥，民取以食之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Tiansheng, in Xingzhou bamboo bore seed like barley, and the people gathered it to eat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Tiansheng, bamboo in Xingzhou bore seed like barley, and the people gathered it to eat.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「竹有實，大饑。」

translations.literal: The omen interpretation says: "When bamboo bears seed, great famine."
translations.idiomatic: The omen interpretation says: "When bamboo bears seed, great famine."

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，有芝生於天安殿柱，召輔臣觀之。

translations.literal: On jiayin in the eighth month, lingzhi grew on a pillar of the Hall of Heavenly Peace, and the emperor summoned the chief ministers to view it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the eighth month, lingzhi grew on a pillar of the Hall of Heavenly Peace, and the emperor summoned the chief ministers to view it.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，城西下木場芝草生。

translations.literal: On wuwu in the ninth month, lingzhi grass grew at the lumber yard below the west wall of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the ninth month, lingzhi grass appeared at the lumber yard below the west wall of the city.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，梓州城門生芝二本。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year, two plants of lingzhi grew at the city gate of Zizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year, two plants of lingzhi grew at the city gate of Zizhou.

sentences.zh: 四年正月。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year.

sentences.zh: 梓州民家生芝四本。

translations.literal: At a commoner's home in Zizhou, four plants of lingzhi grew.
translations.idiomatic: Four plants of lingzhi grew at a commoner's home in Zizhou.

sentences.zh: 九月，榮州芝生。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, lingzhi grew in Rongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, lingzhi appeared in Rongzhou.

sentences.zh: 明道元年七月，榮州、連州並芝生。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Mingdao, lingzhi grew in both Rongzhou and Lianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Mingdao, lingzhi appeared in both Rongzhou and Lianzhou.

sentences.zh: 景祐二年九月，嘉州芝草生。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Jingyou, lingzhi grass grew in Jiazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of Jingyou, lingzhi grass appeared in Jiazhou.

sentences.zh: 四年五月丙寅，有芝生於化成殿楹。

translations.literal: On bingyin in the fifth month of the fourth year, lingzhi grew on a pillar of the Hall of Transformation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the fifth month of the fourth year, lingzhi grew on a pillar of the Hall of Transformation.

sentences.zh: 慶曆元年二月丙午，京師雨藥。

translations.literal: On bingwu in the second month of the first year of Qingli, medicine rained down in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the second month of the first year of Qingli, medicine rained down in the capital.

sentences.zh: 二年八月，梓州芝草生。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year, lingzhi grass grew in Zizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year, lingzhi grass appeared in Zizhou.

sentences.zh: 五年八月，洪州章江禪院堂柱芝草生，高一尺三寸，葉二十一層，色白黃，有紫暈，旁生小芝，葉九層，上有氣如煙。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fifth year, lingzhi grass grew on a hall pillar at Zhangjiang Chan Monastery in Hongzhou; it was one foot three inches tall, with twenty-one layers of foliage, white-yellow in color with a purple halo; a smaller lingzhi grew beside it with nine layers of foliage, and above it vapor rose like smoke.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fifth year, lingzhi grass grew on a hall pillar at Zhangjiang Chan Monastery in Hongzhou, one foot three inches tall with twenty-one layers of white-yellow foliage ringed by a purple halo; a smaller lingzhi grew beside it with nine layers of foliage, and vapor like smoke rose above it.

sentences.zh: 皇祐元年七月，福州生芝一十二本。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Huangyou, twelve plants of lingzhi grew in Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Huangyou, twelve plants of lingzhi appeared in Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十月，湖州芝草生。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, lingzhi grass grew in Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, lingzhi grass appeared in Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年六月丁亥，無爲軍獻芝草凡三百五十本。

translations.literal: On dinghai in the sixth month of the third year, Wuwei Army presented three hundred fifty plants of lingzhi grass in all.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the sixth month of the third year, Wuwei Army presented three hundred fifty plants of lingzhi grass in all.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「朕以豐年爲上瑞，賢臣爲寶，至於草木、魚蟲之異，焉足尚哉！」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "I regard abundant harvests as the highest auspice and worthy ministers as treasures; as for anomalies among plants, trees, fish, and insects, how could they be worth esteeming!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "I regard abundant harvests as the highest auspice and worthy ministers as treasures; as for oddities among plants, trees, fish, and insects, what is there to esteem in them!"

sentences.zh: 五年閏七月，榮州芝草生。

translations.literal: In the intercalary seventh month of the fifth year, lingzhi grass grew in Rongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month of the fifth year, lingzhi grass appeared in Rongzhou.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐三年十一月，河南府芝草生。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year of Jiayou, lingzhi grass grew in Henan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the third year of Jiayou, lingzhi grass appeared in Henan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，清川縣漢光武祠生芝草，一本三岐。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year, at the Temple of Emperor Guangwu of Han in Qingchuan county, lingzhi grass grew—one plant with three prongs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year, lingzhi grass grew at the Temple of Emperor Guangwu of Han in Qingchuan county—one plant forked in three.

sentences.zh: 八月，施州歌羅砦生芝四本。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, four plants of lingzhi grew at Gela Stockade in Shizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, four plants of lingzhi appeared at Gela Stockade in Shizhou.

sentences.zh: 十月，汝州新砦巡檢廨舍生芝五本。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, five plants of lingzhi grew at the headquarters of the Xinzhai patrol inspector in Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, five plants of lingzhi grew at the Xinzhai patrol inspector's headquarters in Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 熙甯元年，益陽縣雷震山裂，出米可數十萬斛，齎至京師，信米也，但色黑如炭。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xining, thunder struck in Yiyang county and split a mountain; rice emerged amounting to several hundred thousand hu. It was sent to the capital—it was genuine rice, but its color was black as charcoal.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xining, thunder split a mountain in Yiyang county and rice poured forth—several hundred thousand hu in all. The grain was sent to the capital. It was real rice, but black as charcoal.

sentences.zh: 八年七月，鼎州產芝三本，其一類珊瑚，枝葉摎結，鹽官縣自三月地產物如珠，可食；

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the eighth year, Dingzhou produced three plants of lingzhi; one resembled coral, its branches and leaves tangled and intertwined. In Yanguan county from the third month the earth produced things like pearls, edible;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the eighth year, Dingzhou produced three plants of lingzhi; one resembled coral, its branches and leaves intricately intertwined. In Yanguan county, from the third month the earth yielded pearl-like growths that could be eaten;

sentences.zh: 水產菜如菌，可爲菹，饑民賴之。

translations.literal: the waters produced vegetables like mushrooms, which could be made into pickles; starving people relied on them.
translations.idiomatic: the waters yielded fungus-like greens fit for pickling, and starving people lived on them.

sentences.zh: 九年五月，流江縣產芝二十一本。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year, Liujiang county produced twenty-one plants of lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the ninth year, Liujiang county produced twenty-one plants of lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 元豐二年四月，眉州生瑞竹。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Yuanfeng, Meizhou produced auspicious bamboo.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of Yuanfeng, auspicious bamboo appeared in Meizhou.

sentences.zh: 六月，忠州雨豆。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, beans rained down in Zhongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, beans rained down in Zhongzhou—a grass prodigy portent.

sentences.zh: 七月甲午，南賓縣雨豆。

translations.literal: On jiawu in the seventh month, beans rained down in Nanbin county.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the seventh month, beans rained down in Nanbin county as well.

sentences.zh: 十一月，全州芝生十二本。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, twelve plants of lingzhi grew in Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, twelve plants of lingzhi appeared in Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年六月，安州芝生二十九本，其一連理。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year, twenty-nine plants of lingzhi grew in Anzhou; one showed joined trunks.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year, twenty-nine plants of lingzhi grew in Anzhou, one with joined trunks.

sentences.zh: 臨江軍芝生四十三本。

translations.literal: Forty-three plants of lingzhi grew in Linjiang Army.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-three plants of lingzhi appeared in Linjiang Army.

sentences.zh: 四年十月，郪縣天慶觀生瑞竹一本，自第九節分莖雙起。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year, one stalk of auspicious bamboo grew at Tianqing Abbey in Qixian county; from the ninth node two stems rose as a pair.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fourth year, a single stalk of auspicious bamboo grew at Tianqing Abbey in Qixian county; from the ninth node two stems sprang up side by side.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，永康縣生紫芝九本。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year, nine plants of purple lingzhi grew in Yongkang county.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year, nine plants of purple lingzhi appeared in Yongkang county.

sentences.zh: 十一月，閬中縣生紫芝六、金芝七。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Langzhong county produced six purple lingzhi and seven golden lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Langzhong county produced six purple lingzhi and seven golden lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 永康縣生紫芝九。

translations.literal: Nine purple lingzhi grew in Yongkang county.
translations.idiomatic: Nine purple lingzhi appeared in Yongkang county.

sentences.zh: 六年八月，吉州芝生三十三本。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the sixth year, thirty-three plants of lingzhi grew in Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the sixth year, thirty-three plants of lingzhi appeared in Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月，滕縣官舍生異草，經月不腐。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, a strange plant grew in the government offices of Teng county; for a full month it did not decay.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, a strange plant sprang up in the government offices of Teng county and did not decay for a full month.

sentences.zh: 七年四月，景靈宮芝生六本於天元殿門。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the seventh year, six plants of lingzhi grew at the gate of the Hall of Heavenly Origin in the Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the seventh year, six plants of lingzhi grew at the gate of the Hall of Heavenly Origin in the Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 五月，開化縣芝生九本，黃白紫色。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, nine plants of lingzhi grew in Kaihua county, in yellow, white, and purple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, nine plants of lingzhi appeared in Kaihua county in yellow, white, and purple.

sentences.zh: 八月，永安陵下宮芝生一本。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, one plant of lingzhi grew at the lower palace of Yong'an Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, one plant of lingzhi grew at the lower palace of Yong'an Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 十月，青州芝生二十一本。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, twenty-one plants of lingzhi grew in Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, twenty-one plants of lingzhi appeared in Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 紹聖三年九月，淄川縣生芝草，有穀十科穿芝草生二枝。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the third year of Shaosheng, lingzhi grass grew in Zichuan county; ten stalks of grain pierced through it, and two branches of lingzhi grew.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the third year of Shaosheng, lingzhi grass grew in Zichuan county where ten grain stalks pierced the plant and two lingzhi branches sprouted from it.

sentences.zh: 十月，河南府大內地生芝草。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, lingzhi grass grew within the inner precincts of Henan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, lingzhi grass appeared within the inner precincts of Henan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元符二年正月，處州民田生瑞竹。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year of Yuanfu, auspicious bamboo grew in a commoner's field in Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Yuanfu, auspicious bamboo sprang up in a commoner's field in Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月，瀘州生芝草一本，同根駢幹，至蓋復合爲一。

translations.literal: In the second month, Luzhou produced one plant of lingzhi grass with a shared root and paired trunks; at the cap they merged again into one.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Luzhou produced one plant of lingzhi grass with a shared root and paired trunks that merged again into a single cap.

sentences.zh: 又衡州郡廳生紫芝一根十六葉。

translations.literal: Also at the commandery hall of Hengzhou, one purple lingzhi grew with sixteen leaves.
translations.idiomatic: At the commandery hall of Hengzhou as well, one purple lingzhi grew with sixteen leaves.

sentences.zh: 崇甯元年八月，磐石縣芝草連理。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Chongning, joined-trunk lingzhi grass grew in Panshi county.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Chongning, joined-trunk lingzhi grass appeared in Panshi county.

sentences.zh: 三年十月，復州、澤州芝草生。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year, lingzhi grass grew in Fuzhou and Zezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the third year, lingzhi grass appeared in Fuzhou and Zezhou.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，戎州、宿州芝草生。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, lingzhi grass grew in Rongzhou and Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, lingzhi grass appeared in Rongzhou and Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 七月，瀘州芝草、瑞竹生。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, lingzhi grass and auspicious bamboo grew in Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, lingzhi grass and auspicious bamboo appeared in Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 五年冬，澶州、安州芝草生。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fifth year, lingzhi grass grew in Cizhou and Anzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fifth year, lingzhi grass appeared in Cizhou and Anzhou.

sentences.zh: 政和元年正月，萊州芝草生。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Zhenghe, lingzhi grass grew in Laizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Zhenghe, lingzhi grass appeared in Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月，虔州聖祖殿芝草生。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, lingzhi grass grew at the Hall of the Sacred Ancestor in Qianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, lingzhi grass appeared at the Hall of the Sacred Ancestor in Qianzhou.

sentences.zh: 二年二月戊子，河南府新安縣蟾蜍背生芝草。

translations.literal: On wuzi in the second month of the second year, lingzhi grass grew on the back of a toad in Xin'an county, Henan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the second month of the second year, lingzhi grass sprouted on the back of a toad in Xin'an county, Henan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 自是而後，祥瑞日聞。

translations.literal: From then on, auspicious portents were reported day after day.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, reports of auspicious portents came in day after day.

sentences.zh: 玉芝產禁中殆無虛歲，凡殿宇、園苑及妃嬪位皆有之。

translations.literal: Jade lingzhi appeared within the Forbidden City almost every year without fail; palaces, gardens, and the quarters of consorts all had them.
translations.idiomatic: Jade lingzhi appeared within the Forbidden City nearly every year without exception—in palace halls, gardens, and the quarters of consorts alike.

sentences.zh: 外則中書尚書二省、太學、醫學亦產紫芝。

translations.literal: Outside, the two departments of the Secretariat and Chancellery, the Imperial College, and the Medical College also produced purple lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the palace, the Secretariat-Chancellery offices, the Imperial College, and the Medical College also produced purple lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，建州境內竹生米數千萬石。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year, bamboo within Jianzhou produced grain numbering tens of millions of shi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year, bamboo throughout Jianzhou bore grain in amounts reckoned at tens of millions of shi.

sentences.zh: 五年十一月癸酉，越州承天寺瑞竹一竿七枝，幹相似，其葉圓細，生花結實。

translations.literal: On guiyou in the eleventh month of the fifth year, one stalk of auspicious bamboo with seven branches grew at Chengtian Temple in Yuezhou; the stems were alike, the leaves round and fine, and it flowered and bore fruit.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the eleventh month of the fifth year, a single stalk of auspicious bamboo with seven branches appeared at Chengtian Temple in Yuezhou; the stems matched one another, the leaves were round and fine, and the plant flowered and bore fruit.

sentences.zh: 詔送秘書省，仍拜表賀。

translations.literal: An edict ordered it sent to the Secretariat and a congratulatory memorial submitted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered it sent to the Secretariat, and officials submitted a memorial of congratulation.

sentences.zh: 五年五月，禁中芭蕉連理。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year, plantain trees with joined trunks appeared within the Forbidden City.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifth year, plantain trees with joined trunks appeared within the Forbidden City.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，蘄州進芝草一萬一千六百枝，內一枝紫色，九幹。

translations.literal: On jiazi in the eighth month, Qizhou presented eleven thousand six hundred sprigs of lingzhi grass, among them one purple specimen with nine stems.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the eighth month, Qizhou presented eleven thousand six hundred sprigs of lingzhi grass, including one purple specimen with nine stems.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，汝州進六萬本，其間連理、雙枝者一千八百八十，有司不勝其紀。

translations.literal: On jiwei in the twelfth month, Ruzhou presented sixty thousand plants; among them one thousand eight hundred eighty showed joined trunks or paired branches—the authorities could not keep full records.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the twelfth month, Ruzhou presented sixty thousand plants, of which one thousand eight hundred eighty bore joined trunks or paired branches—the authorities could not keep up with the tally.

sentences.zh: 初猶表賀，後以爲常，不皆賀也。

translations.literal: At first memorials of congratulations were still submitted; later it became routine, and congratulations were not offered for every case.
